title: Le recenti dinamiche della produttività e le trasformazioni del sistema produttivo (Recent Productivity Trends and Transformations in Italy's Production System)
affiliations: Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Bank of Italy, Organization for Economic Co-Operation and Development (OECD) and Bank of Italy

detail.title: Le recenti dinamiche della produttività e le trasformazioni del sistema produttivo (Recent Productivity Trends and Transformations in Italy's Production System)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Bank of Italy Occasional Paper No. 953
publicationDetails.journalName: Bank of Italy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Italian abstract: Tra il 2019 e il 2024 l’economia italiana ha registrato una crescita del PIL superiore alla media dell’area dell’euro e a quella del precedente quinquennio. L’espansione è stata trainata soprattutto dal settore privato, dove il valore aggiunto è aumentato di quasi il 10 per cento, beneficiando in larga parte di un generoso stimolo fiscale. Ha riguardato soprattutto le costruzioni e i servizi, mentre la manifattura ha rallentato. La crescita è stata trainata dall’espansione dell’occupazione, a fronte di una dinamica più debole della produttività del lavoro, in calo negli ultimi due anni. Nel tessuto produttivo si registrano l’aumento della dimensione media delle imprese (che resta inferiore alla media dell’area), nonché della loro redditività e propensione ad investire. La produttività d’impresa è stata sostenuta da processi riallocativi e di crescita interna, dalle multinazionali e dalla dinamicità di quelle alla frontiera dell’efficienza produttiva. È, tuttavia, aumentato il divario tra le imprese migliori e il resto del tessuto produttivo. Per colmare il ritardo di produttività rispetto ai principali paesi europei, e a fronte dei recenti segnali di indebolimento, il tessuto produttivo dovrà rafforzarsi in maniera più diffusa e sarà cruciale promuovere una più ampia adozione di tecnologie avanzate.

English abstract: Between 2019 and 2024, the Italian economy recorded GDP growth that exceeded both the euro-area average and that of the previous five-year period. The expansion was mainly driven by the private sector, where value added increased by nearly 10 per cent, largely benefiting from a generous fiscal stimulus. Growth was concentrated in construction and services, while manufacturing slowed. It was fuelled by rising employment, while labour productivity declined over the past two years. The productive system saw an increase in the average firm size (which remains below the euro-area average), as well as in profitability and investment propensity. Firm-level productivity was supported by reallocation and internal growth processes, by multinational companies, and by the dynamism of firms at the productivity frontier. However, the gap between the most efficient firms and the rest of the productive system widened. To close the productivity gap with major European countries – and in light of recent signs of weakening – the production system will need to be strengthened more broadly, and fostering a wider adoption of advanced technologies will be crucial.

AI.tldr: 2019-2024年意大利经济增长超过欧元区平均水平，主要由私营部门推动，受益于财政刺激。就业增长驱动扩张，但劳动生产率下降。企业规模、盈利能力和投资倾向有所改善，但生产效率差距扩大。需要更广泛的技术采用来缩小与欧洲主要国家的生产率差距。
AI.research_question: 2019-2024年意大利经济增长的主要驱动因素是什么？意大利与欧洲主要国家在生产率方面存在哪些差距？
AI.motivation: 分析意大利经济在2019-2024年期间的表现，识别增长驱动因素和结构性挑战，为缩小与欧洲主要国家的生产率差距提供政策建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济增长理论、生产率分析框架、企业动态理论、财政政策效应分析
AI.method: 宏观经济数据分析、部门比较分析、企业层面生产率评估、跨国比较研究
AI.findings: 1)意大利GDP增长超过欧元区平均和前五年水平；2)私营部门增加值增长近10%，主要受益于财政刺激；3)建筑业和服务业增长强劲，制造业放缓；4)就业扩张驱动增长，但劳动生产率下降；5)企业规模、盈利能力和投资倾向改善；6)生产效率差距扩大；7)跨国公司和高效率前沿企业表现突出
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了财政刺激对经济增长影响的新证据，揭示了企业层面生产率差异扩大的现象，丰富了发展中经济体生产率收敛理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为意大利政策制定者提供了缩小生产率差距的具体方向，强调了广泛采用先进技术的重要性，为企业提升竞争力提供了参考路径

title: Financial Leverage in Private Equity Acquisitions: Debt as a Strategic Driver of Governance and Value Creation

detail.title: Financial Leverage in Private Equity Acquisitions: Debt as a Strategic Driver of Governance and Value Creation
detail.abstract:
Private Equity (PE) acquisitions have become a central mechanism for value creation in contemporary corporate finance. Among the tools at the disposal of PE firms, financial leverage plays a pivotal role, not merely as a source of funding but as a strategic instrument that influences both governance structures and operational performance.

Leverage Buyouts (LBOs) typically employ a combination of equity and substantial debt, allowing firms to acquire companies while amplifying potential returns on investment.

The use of leverage introduces a dual effect: it imposes financial discipline on management, incentivizing efficiency and cash flow generation, while simultaneously affecting governance through covenants, incentive schemes, and contractual protections such as drag-alone or tag-alone rights. Furthermore, leverage can drive value creation, whether by enhancing operational performance in well-performing targets or by enabling complex turnarounds in distressed companies.

This paper explores the strategic role of leverage in PE acquisitions by examining both theoretical frameworks and practical implications. Through selected case studies, it illustrates how the structuring of debt influences managerial decision-making, operational improvements, and ultimately, investor returns. By bridging academic concepts with real-world applications, the paper highlights the multifaceted impact of leverage beyond its financial function, positioning it as a critical tool for strategic management and value maximization in private equity transactions.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了杠杆在私募股权收购中的战略作用，分析了财务杠杆如何不仅作为融资工具，更作为影响治理结构和运营绩效的战略工具，通过案例研究展示了债务结构如何影响管理决策和投资回报。
AI.research_question: 财务杠杆在私募股权收购中扮演什么样的战略角色？它如何影响公司治理结构和运营绩效？
AI.motivation: 私募股权收购已成为现代公司金融中价值创造的核心机制，财务杠杆作为关键工具，其战略作用超越了单纯的融资功能，需要深入理解其对治理和运营的多方面影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司金融理论、代理理论、资本结构理论，探讨杠杆收购(LBOs)的理论基础，包括财务杠杆对管理激励、治理机制和价值创造的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用理论分析与案例研究相结合的方法，通过精选案例研究债务结构对管理决策、运营改进和投资回报的实际影响。
AI.findings: 杠杆具有双重效应：一方面通过财务纪律约束管理层，激励效率提升和现金流产生；另一方面通过契约条款、激励机制和合同保护影响治理结构，在不同情境下驱动价值创造。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了财务杠杆的理论理解，将其从单纯的融资工具提升为战略管理工具，丰富了私募股权价值创造机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为私募股权从业者提供了杠杆结构设计的实践指导，帮助更好地利用杠杆作为战略工具来最大化交易价值，提升投资回报。

title: Patient or Pushing? New Institutional Ownership and the Shareholder-Value Orientation of European Non-Financial Firms
affiliations: University of Groningen - Faculty of Economics and Business

detail.title: Patient or Pushing? New Institutional Ownership and the Shareholder-Value Orientation of European Non-Financial Firms

declarations.funderStatement: Parts of this project have been funded by the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) under Germany's Excellence Strategy – EXC 2126/1– 390838866

detail.abstract: Can we identify a systematic correlation between the emergence of new institutional investors concomitant processes of corporate financialization? Shedding light on this issue this paper contributes to the burgeoning literature on the new political economy of the firm in the era of global finance. Conceptually it develops a framework that links the formation of Asset Manager Capitalism – a new corporate governance regime coined by the re-concentration of ownership – to corporate financialization – a multidimensional process affecting the generation and distribution of profits within and outside the firm. Empirically, the paper applies different econometric estimation techniques to a novel and unique panel of 1,472 firms from 31 European countries and 8 economic sectors over the 2010-19 decade. The results show robust, yet ambiguous and surprising associations between Big Three and Sovereign Wealth Fund shareholdings and corporate financialization that deserve further attention. While the acquisition of financial assets by highly leveraged corporations seems to have come to a hold, new institutional ownership correlates with a stronger shareholder value orientation. Future research might investigate further the necessary context factors and potential causal mechanisms behind these variegated trends.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨新型机构投资者（特别是"三巨头"资产管理公司和主权财富基金）与公司金融化之间的系统性关联，通过欧洲1472家公司的面板数据分析发现两者存在稳健但复杂的关系。
AI.research_question: 新型机构投资者的出现与公司金融化过程之间是否存在系统性关联？
AI.motivation: 为全球金融时代下公司新政治经济学的新兴文献做出贡献，理解资产管理者资本主义与公司金融化之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产管理者资本主义理论框架，将所有权重新集中的新型公司治理机制与公司金融化过程联系起来。
AI.method: 应用多种计量经济学估计技术，分析2010-2019年间31个欧洲国家、8个经济部门的1472家公司的面板数据。
AI.findings: 发现"三巨头"资产管理公司和主权财富基金持股与公司金融化之间存在稳健但模糊和令人惊讶的关联；高杠杆公司的金融资产收购似乎已经停滞；新型机构所有权与更强的股东价值导向相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了连接资产管理者资本主义与公司金融化的概念框架，为理解新型机构投资者对公司财务行为的影响提供理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业管理者提供了关于新型机构投资者如何影响公司金融化决策的实证证据，指出了需要进一步研究的背景因素和因果机制。

title: The Pitfalls of Continuous Heavy-Tailed Distributions in High-Frequency Data Analysis
affiliations: University of Economics, Prague

detail.title: The Pitfalls of Continuous Heavy-Tailed Distributions in High-Frequency Data Analysis
detail.abstract: We address the challenges of modeling high-frequency integer price changes in financial markets using continuous distributions, particularly the Student's t-distribution. We demonstrate that traditional GARCH models, which rely on continuous distributions, are ill-suited for high-frequency data due to the discreteness of price changes. We propose a modification to the maximum likelihood estimation procedure that accounts for the discrete nature of observations while still using continuous distributions. Our approach involves modeling the log-likelihood in terms of intervals corresponding to the rounding of continuous price changes to the nearest integer. The findings highlight the importance of adjusting for discreteness in volatility analysis and provide a framework for incroporating any continuous distribution for modeling high-frequency prices.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高频金融数据中整数价格变化的建模挑战，提出了一种考虑离散性的最大似然估计改进方法，解决了传统连续分布模型在高频数据中的不适用性问题。
AI.research_question: 如何有效建模高频金融数据中的整数价格变化，克服传统连续分布模型在处理离散观测值时的局限性？
AI.motivation: 传统GARCH模型依赖连续分布，但高频金融数据中的价格变化是离散的整数形式，导致连续分布模型在此类数据上表现不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最大似然估计理论，结合连续分布（如学生t分布）和离散观测的区间建模框架。
AI.method: 提出改进的最大似然估计方法，通过将连续价格变化四舍五入到最近整数的对应区间来建模对数似然函数。
AI.findings: 调整离散性对波动率分析至关重要，该方法为使用任何连续分布建模高频价格提供了框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了考虑数据离散性的高频金融建模理论框架，扩展了连续分布在离散数据中的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融从业者提供了处理高频整数价格数据的实用建模方法，提高了波动率估计的准确性。

title: House Price Responses to Monetary Policy Surprises: Evidence from the U.S. Listings Data
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), Government of Canada - Bank of Canada and Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco

detail.title: House Price Responses to Monetary Policy Surprises: Evidence from the U.S. Listings Data
detail.abstract:
This paper presents direct evidence of the immediate causal impact of interest rates on U.S. house prices. Using detailed microdata on daily house listings from 2001 to
2019 and high-frequency monetary policy shocks, the analysis reveals three findings: (1) House prices react within weeks, significantly faster than previously thought. (2)
These effects are primarily driven by surprises to medium- and long-term interest rates. (3) The magnitude of house price responses is comparable to that of stock prices
on announcement days. These findings offer crucial insights for central bankers to more precisely gauge policy effects and mitigate housing market imbalances.

AI.tldr: 通过高频数据分析发现美国房价对利率变动反应快速，主要受中长期利率影响，反应程度与股票相似
AI.research_question: 利率变动对美国房价的即期因果影响是什么？

title: What Makes a Paper Seminal? Evidence from 80 Years of Economic Research
affiliations: Frankfurt School of Finance & Management and University of Cape Town

detail.title: What Makes a Paper Seminal? Evidence from 80 Years of Economic Research
detail.abstract: We study what makes an economics paper seminal, using 29,823 articles published in a Top-5 economics journal between 1940 and 2020. Seminal papers are in the Top-1% of within-year citations 16-20 years after publication and continue to accumulate citations, while citations to early hit papers peak 1-5 years after publication. Author prolificness strongly predicts seminality, whereas seniority does not. Co-author network centralities do not predict seminality, although they predict papers' broader influence. Conditional on being Top-5 publication, affiliation rank is not a reliable predictor of seminality and is weakly favorable to lower-ranked affiliations. Combinatorial novelty is insignificant or negatively correlated with seminality, while semantic novelty of abstracts is uninformative. Figures correlate with seminality, whereas tables mainly predict broad influence in the "empirical era." Authors with one additional seminal paper are 1.76 pp more likely to eventually become Nobel laureates.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了1940-2020年间Top5经济学期刊的29,823篇论文，发现开创性论文具有持续高引用特征，作者多产性而非资历是重要预测因素，网络中心性和机构排名预测作用有限，图表使用与开创性相关，诺贝尔奖得主更可能拥有多篇开创性论文。
AI.research_question: 什么因素使经济学论文成为开创性（seminal）论文？
AI.motivation: 理解开创性论文的特征和预测因素，有助于识别和培育具有长期影响力的学术研究
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学计量学和文献计量学理论，结合社会网络分析和文本分析方法
AI.method: 使用29,823篇Top5经济学期刊论文的引用数据，采用计量经济学方法分析开创性论文的特征和预测因素
AI.findings: 开创性论文具有持续高引用特征；作者多产性是强预测因素；网络中心性预测广泛影响力而非开创性；机构排名预测作用有限；组合新颖性不显著；图表使用与开创性相关；诺贝尔奖得主更可能拥有多篇开创性论文
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了开创性论文的识别标准，揭示了开创性论文与早期热门论文的区别，丰富了科学计量学理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术评价、人才识别和科研管理提供了实证依据，有助于优化科研资源配置和学术评价体系

title: Labor Turnover, Information Production, and Bank Risk
affiliations: Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) - Brazilian School of Public and Business Administration (EBAPE), Brazilian Central Bank and Lee Shau Kee School of Business and Administration, Hong Kong Metropolitan University

detail.title: Labor Turnover, Information Production, and Bank Risk

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco Central do Brasil, Working Paper Series, no. 626, August 2025.

detail.abstract: We investigate the theoretical mechanisms through which labor turnover adversely affects bank risk and performance. Using monthly matched employer-employee data from Brazil during 2003-2019, we find banks with higher labor turnover show lower risk buffers, higher loan growth, and lower profitability. These adverse effects align with the firm-specific human capital theory. Consistent with our identifying assumptions, the effects are stronger when turnover reduces experience and expertise, among loan officers, as well as across cities and banks. Placebo tests and further analyses confirm our results. The evidence suggests that high labor turnover impairs bank information production, increasing risk and lowering performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现银行员工流失率过高会通过降低风险缓冲、增加贷款增长和降低盈利能力来负面影响银行风险和绩效，这些效应符合企业特定人力资本理论。
AI.research_question: 劳动力流动如何通过理论机制对银行风险和绩效产生不利影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨劳动力流动对银行风险管理和绩效的理论影响机制，填补相关研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业特定人力资本理论 - 员工流失导致银行特有知识和经验的损失，影响信息生产能力。
AI.method: 使用2003-2019年巴西月度匹配的雇主-员工数据，进行实证分析，包括安慰剂检验和进一步分析。
AI.findings: 劳动力流失率较高的银行表现出较低的风险缓冲、较高的贷款增长和较低的盈利能力；当流失减少经验和专业知识时效应更强，特别是在信贷员、城市和银行层面。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了企业特定人力资本理论在银行业的适用性，揭示了劳动力流动通过损害银行信息生产影响风险绩效的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层提供了关于控制员工流失重要性的实证证据，有助于银行改善人力资源管理和风险控制实践。

title: Modulating a neural marker of outcome valence as a function of intention: Feedback-related negativity (FRN) reduction when wins are treated as losses
affiliations: University of Alberta and University of Alberta

detail.title: Modulating a neural marker of outcome valence as a function of intention: Feedback-related negativity (FRN) reduction when wins are treated as losses
detail.abstract: Losses are known to negatively affect decision-making, leading to inflexible and predictable behaviours, when the intention is to win as much as possible (win-maximization). This study aims to explore whether outcome valence can be reconfigured at both the behavioural and neurophysiological levels with a reversed goal state: to lose as much as possible (loss-maximization). Participants (n = 39) were asked to play a binary-response paradigm against an exploitable opponent while their electroencephalogram (EEG) was recorded. For one half of the experiment, participants were asked to win as much as possible, while for the other half, they were asked to lose as much as possible. Participants exhibited comparable degrees of shift and stay behaviours across the given goals, demonstrating flexible and symmetrical behavioural reconfiguration. At the neurophysiological level, FRN amplitudes to wins decreased during loss-maximization relative to win-maximization, while the amplitudes to losses remained comparable. These results emphasize the asymmetrical effects of wins and losses at a neurophysiological level, compared to the symmetrical decision-making at the behavioural level.

title: Should the United States Give People Money? Evidence from High-Quality Empirical Research on Unconditional Cash Transfers

detail.title: Should the United States Give People Money? Evidence from High-Quality Empirical Research on Unconditional Cash Transfers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I performed data analytic work for Baby's First Years randomized controlled trial in 2022. However, the views expressed here are my own independent assessment of the publicly available research.

contentType.other: Forthcoming publication in the Kansas Journal of Law & Public Policy

detail.abstract:
Unconditional cash is a popular tool for people of all political stripes, forming the basis of policy proposals like Universal Basic Income and an expanded Child Tax Credit. Many rationales for unconditional cash exist. Some defend the policy on efficiency grounds, with arguments that cash is preferable to in-kind support, that it would generate greater economic benefits than costs, or even that it would pay for itself. Others argue for unconditional cash on moral grounds, saying that it would improve recipients' lives, reduce poverty, and lead to a more egalitarian society.

Over the past decade, researchers have conducted multiple high-quality studies to assess the effects of transfers of up to $12,000 in yearly unconditional cash lasting several years. This essay surveys this latest round of research to determine which policy rationales for unconditional cash transfers it supports-if any. It finds that the research supports the moral arguments for unconditional cash transfers more strongly than the efficiency arguments, but that uncertainties remain regarding unconditional cash's long-term effects.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了无条件现金转移支付的最新研究，发现研究结果更支持道德层面的论证（改善生活、减少贫困、促进平等），而非效率层面的论证（现金优于实物支持、经济效益大于成本、自给自足），但对长期效果仍存在不确定性。

AI.findings: 研究结果更强烈支持道德论证（现金转移能改善接收者生活、减少贫困、促进更平等社会），而对效率论证的支持相对较弱，且长期效果存在不确定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了无条件现金转移支付理论论证的实证基础，区分了效率论证和道德论证的实际支持程度，为相关政策辩论提供了实证依据。

title: The Neoliberal Era Thus Far: An Appraisal

detail.title: The Neoliberal Era Thus Far: An Appraisal
detail.abstract: This note offers a brief summation of the record of neoliberal policymaking--its principal objects, the extent to which it achieved its object, and furthermore the extent to which in doing so it realized the hopes held and promises made for it. Where all this is concerned the author specifically identifies the "practical" side of the neoliberal project with the rollback of the "industrial development-welfare-macroeconomic management state," and holds that the reformers accomplished much of what they endeavored to do on this point. (If they did not "shrink" the state as some envisaged, they did succeed in arresting its formerly rapid growth, and profoundly altered its resourcing and functioning in line with the tenets of neoliberal ideology.) The result saw business gain enormous latitude, and elites benefit significantly from the economic trend, but distinctly failed to realize the promises made for it with regard to the rejuvenation of industry in mature industrial powers, industrialize less developed economies, restore the growth rates of the post-war boom era, and raise popular living standards--a fact which has generated much discontent. However, reflecting the situation elites remain supportive of neoliberal prescriptions, and the associated (privatized, financialized) neoliberal "model," as for the time being opposition to neoliberalism has been ineffectual, with the result that claims of neoliberalism's demise have been "greatly exaggerated."

detail.abstract: In recent decades, most countries are structured on free market or mixed economies. This points to Adam Smith's idea of the invisible hand, that humans are driven by utility maximising. This suggests that individuals pursuing self-interests like profit will unintentionally benefit the overall well-being of society through market mechanisms. Capitalist economies and firms operate under similar incentives, especially countries transitioning. Today's economy shows this through, entrepreneurial risk, speculative investment, and efficiency-driven decisions. detail.title: Robust Pricing with Limited Demand Information
detail.abstract: How should a firm price its product when facing limited information about the demand curve? We propose the guaranteed profit ratio (GPR)-the minimum ratio of realized profit to ex-post optimal profit across all potential demand curves-as a criterion for evaluating pricing performance. We characterize prices that maximize this ratio and identify the demand curves that attain it, given only coarse demand information. An illustrative example shows that a GPR-optimal price yields higher realized profit than a price maximizing worst-case profit for most curves considered, and the reasoning suggests that this pattern could extend to broader demand environments.

detail.abstract: It is widely recognized in demographic theories that structural constraints, such as the financial costs of child-rearing, future economic uncertainties, and gender inequities, play a central role in shaping individual fertility intentions. However, previous research often examines these factors in isolation, hindering theoretical integration and effective policymaking. By employing a factorial survey experiment across six countries (US, Spain, Sweden, urban China, South Korea, Japan), we integrate five dominant theoretical perspectives into a unified framework, manipulating the degree of each constraint to assess its relative importance in shaping fertility intentions. Our findings indicate that economic factors, particularly the financial burden and uncertainties regarding future economic conditions, are the most critical structural constraints. They are followed by insufficient workplace and intergenerational family support, as well as gender inequity. In contrast, social norms and values related to fertility were found to be the least influential. Moreover, the relative importance of these structural constraints varies by gender and national contexts, reflecting differences in cultural norms, family dynamics, and institutional frameworks. By integrating multiple perspectives into a unified framework, this study underscores the predominant role of economic factors in shaping fertility intentions, even amid broader cultural shifts associated with demographic transitions and individualistic values.

detail.abstract: This article explores the legal framework governing trademark registration, infringement, and enforcement in Nigeria, with a focus on the significance of timely renewal and due diligence clearance before registering a trademark. It highlights how trademarks serve as critical tools for businesses in building brand identity, protecting goodwill, and promoting consumer trust. The paper analyses key provisions of the Nigerian Trademarks Act and related statutes, outlining the requirements for valid registration, duration and infringement, and remedies available for infringement. A detailed case study of Citilink Accesscorp Ltd v MTN Nigeria Communications Plc illustrates modern trademark warfare and the risks of lapses in rights management. Drawing lessons from the dispute, the article underscores the need for proactive IP strategies and cautions against reliance on litigation, given its costs and uncertainties. It concludes with practical recommendations for brand owners seeking to strengthen their trademark portfolios in Nigeria's evolving commercial landscape.

declarations.funderStatement: I received some grants from the George Mason University Institute of Humane Studies to present the paper at conferences.

detail.abstract:
The Framers of the federal Constitution said almost nothing about how subordinate officers would be held accountable. This Article provides one overlooked explanation for this longstanding puzzle. The Constitution was enacted against a well-defined jurisprudence that has largely fallen from view: a law of officers. When using the term “Officer” and its framework of “Duties,” the Constitution invoked a distinctive method of regulating state power, in which officers were personally responsible—and liable—for discharging duties defined by law. The Framers and Ratifiers of the Constitution expected that these common-law rules would fill the gap left by the document’s silence.

This Article weaves together the strands of statutory and common law that constituted and regulated the early American officer. This system of legal organization, drawn from longstanding English and colonial practice, empowered officers to create a decentralized governing apparatus that blurred the line between public and private. Its regime of harsh personal liability and individual empowerment impeded efforts to construct a top-down hierarchy by empowering and encouraging officers to resist orders from their superiors. As Americans developed a bureaucratic state over the nineteenth- and twentieth centuries, judges and lawmakers replaced this officer-based paradigm of governance with a system of administrative law that was more conducive to the modern state.

The legal regime of early American officeholding is inconsistent with many originalist justifications of the “unitary executive theory,” which assert that the Constitution relies on a combination of managerial control and presidential elections to discipline the state. Because the traditional law of officers centered officers’ independent obligations to law rather than to the executive hierarchy, it actively frustrated efforts to construct the command-and-control executive branch that unitarists believe the Constitution requires. The unitarists implicitly impose a theory of the state that developed as the early American law of officers was fading from view.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国宪法制定者为何对下级官员问责机制保持沉默，指出这是因为宪法建立在已被遗忘的"官员法"传统之上，该传统强调官员对法律而非行政层级的个人责任。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国宪法对下级官员的问责机制保持沉默？这种沉默背后的法律传统是什么？
AI.motivation: 解决宪法制定者为何几乎未提及下级官员问责机制这一长期存在的谜题，揭示被忽视的法律传统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 官员法（law of officers）理论框架，强调官员个人对法律义务的责任和问责机制
AI.method: 历史法律分析，结合制定法和普通法的研究，追溯英国和殖民地时期的官员法律传统
AI.findings: 宪法制定者预期普通法规则会填补宪法沉默的空白；早期美国官员制度强调个人责任和分散治理，阻碍了自上而下的层级控制；现代行政法取代了这种官员本位治理模式
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"单一行政理论"的原旨主义论证，揭示了宪法制定时的不同国家理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国宪法官员问责机制提供了新的历史视角，对当代行政法理论具有重要启示意义

title: Development and analysis of single stop trip chain travel patterns
affiliations: Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University

detail.title: Development and analysis of single stop trip chain travel patterns
detail.abstract: Trip chain patterns are developed from the 1995 NPTS data set according to trip chain definition using a computer program that comprises trip chain building conditions and criteria. The software that is used to develop the program is Statistical Analysis System (SAS). There are five variables (household characteristics) that are selected to be used in analyzing trip chaining in this research. The construction process of trip chaining reveals fourteen different single stop trip chain patterns. The results show that the most frequent single stop trip chain pattern is Home-Work-Home which is designated numerically as "170117". The percent of trip chains of this single work stop trip chain pattern is 12.10% of overall trip chains and 20.34% of total single stop trip chain patterns. The percentages of households that generate different frequencies of single stop trip chain patterns during the day are 75% once, 19% twice, 4% three times, 2% four times, and 1% five times or more. The results show in general that households with two people, two worker, two vehicle, 1 adult, no children, and an income is equal to $60000 and above represent the highest percent of households and trip chains compared to other classes of household characteristics. The ratio of number of trip chains to households is computed. This rate is called trip chain generation rate (TCGR). It is calculated in two different ways in which the calculation is characterized by a trip chain pattern and a certain household characteristic, then the calculations are characterized by a trip pattern, a certain household characteristic, and a trip chain frequency. TCGR is directly proportional to the number of workers within household and the average increasing rate is about 20%. The rate of increase as the class size increases is almost steady for household vehicle, size and income and the average increasing rates are about 8%, 6%, and 2% respectively. The results show that the class of household size has an obvious effect on generating trip chains of the other selected trip chains patterns. The most affected trip chain pattern by household size is Home-Religious activity-Home and the second most affected are Home-Other Social/Recreational-Home and Home-Went out to Eat-Home trip chain patterns. In general, it has been found that with increase of the class of household characteristics, the TCGR increases with different variations in the increasing rates from certain trip chain pattern to another. Generally, the tendency of generating one trip chain per day is decreasing as the class of household characteristics increases while generating more than one trip per day is increasing as the class of household characteristics increases with some variation of the increasing or decreasing rates among trip chain patterns. Household size characteristic is statistically significant correlated to the development of all selected single stop trip chain pattern and it is the most important variable for all trip chain patterns except Home-Work-Home. Finally, all household characteristics are statistically significant correlated to Home-Work-Home and the most important variables are number of workers and number of vehicles within households.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文使用1995年NPTS数据集，通过SAS软件构建了14种单停面旅游链模式，分析了家庭特征对旅游链生成的影响。最常见模式为Home-Work-Home，占总体的12.10%。家庭特征中工作人数和车辆数对工作旅游链最为重要，而家庭规模则对其他旅游链模式有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 不同家庭特征如何影响单停面旅游链模式的生成频率和特征？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭特征与旅游链模式之间的关系，为交通规划和管理提供基础数据支持
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于旅游链构建理论，采用统计分析方法来研究家庭特征变量对旅游模式的影响
AI.method: 使用SAS软件开发程序，基于1995年NPTS数据集，通过旅游链构建条件和标准识别出14种单停面旅游链模式，并分析5个家庭特征变量
AI.findings: 1）最常见模式为Home-Work-Home（12.10%）；2）75%家庭每天只生成一次旅游链；3）工作人数增加20%导致TCGR增加；4）家庭规模对宗教活动等非工作旅游链有显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了旅游链生成率（TCGR）模型，揭示了不同家庭特征变量与特定旅游链模式之间的统计关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通规划者提供了家庭特征对旅游模式影响的实证数据，能够预测不同类型家庭的旅游需求，为基础设施规划和交通管理提供决策支持

title: When Is AI Advice Good Enough to Travel On? An Uncertainty Reduction Theory-Based Analysis of Informational, Cognitive, and Temporal Uncertainties
affiliations: Chaoyang University of Technology, Chaoyang University of Technology, Chaoyang University of Technology and Chaoyang University of Technology

detail.title: When Is AI Advice Good Enough to Travel On? An Uncertainty Reduction Theory-Based Analysis of Informational, Cognitive, and Temporal Uncertainties
detail.abstract: Generative-AI chatbots promise frictionless trip planning, but travelers often confront dense or outdated answers. Guided by Uncertainty Reduction Theory, this study models how informational, cognitive and temporal uncertainties shape tourists’ trust in ChatGPT and how online-review credibility conditions these effects. Survey evidence shows temporal and informational gaps consistently undermine clarity, whereas cognitive opacity matters little. Travelers restore confidence mainly through iterative clarification with the bot; peer feedback is helpful only when anchored in highly credible reviews, revealing a boundary for social proof. Once uncertainty falls, intentions to visit recommended destinations and to continue using ChatGPT both strengthen, with technology loyalty further amplifying destination appeal. The research extends URT to generative AI by isolating temporal uncertainty and demonstrating that review credibility gates the value of social validation. Practically, it urges designers and destination managers to surface timestamps, evidence prompts and verified reviews, turning AI curiosity into confident, actionable itineraries.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于不确定性减少理论，探讨ChatGPT在旅游规划中信息、认知和时间不确定性对用户信任的影响，以及在线评论可信度的调节作用。研究发现时间信息缺口最影响信任，用户主要通过迭代澄清恢复信心，高可信度评论才能有效提供社会验证。降低不确定性后，用户访问推荐目的地和继续使用ChatGPT的意愿都会增强。
AI.research_question: 信息不确定性、认知不确定性和时间不确定性如何影响游客对ChatGPT的信任？在线评论可信度如何调节这些影响？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI聊天机器人承诺提供无缝旅行规划，但旅行者经常遇到信息密集或过时的回答，需要理解这些不确定性如何影响用户信任和使用意愿。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性减少理论（Uncertainty Reduction Theory），重点关注信息不确定性、认知不确定性和时间不确定性三个维度。
AI.method: 问卷调查方法，收集实证数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 时间和信息缺口持续削弱清晰度，认知不透明性影响较小；2. 旅行者主要通过与机器人的迭代澄清恢复信心；3. 同行反馈仅在高度可信的评论中才有帮助；4. 不确定性降低后，访问推荐目的地和继续使用ChatGPT的意愿都会增强；5. 技术忠诚度进一步放大目的地吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不确定性减少理论扩展到生成式AI领域，分离出时间不确定性维度，证明评论可信度是社会验证价值的门槛条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议设计者和目的地管理者展示时间戳、证据提示和经过验证的评论，将AI好奇心转化为自信、可操作的行程规划。

title: Democratic Responsiveness to Consumer Interests in Trade Policy
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Political Science

detail.title: Democratic Responsiveness to Consumer Interests in Trade Policy

publicationDetails.detailsText: MIT Political Science Department Research Paper No. 2023-5
publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Political Science Department Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Why are some states more open to international trade than others? Although existing explanations emphasize the influence of voters as consumers who benefit from lower tariffs, recent research suggests that democracy does not improve policy responsiveness: high consumption goods with greater impact on voter spending have higher tariffs. These findings contradict observations of pro-poor policies implemented by leaders in low-income democracies. I argue that democratic leaders are incentivized to pay attention to voter interest only on salient products. Leveraging the World Bank Consumption Database and a new merging strategy with fine-grained tariff data, I find that high consumption foodstuff, which tend to be politically salient essential goods, receive lower tariffs. This effect is more pronounced in low-income democracies, where the citizenry is more sensitive to the price of foods, increasing their salience. These findings suggest that democratic leaders do care about voter interests, but only on high salience issues.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析高消费食品的关税政策，发现民主国家的领导人仅在高显著性问题上关注选民利益，尤其是低收入民主国家中的基础食品。
AI.research_question: 为什么某些国家更开放国际贸易？民主领导人如何在贸易政策中应对选民利益？
AI.motivation: 现有研究指出民主并不能提高政策响应性，高消费品反而有更高关税，这与低收入民主国家的惠民政筶观察相矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治显著性理论 - 民主领导人仅在高显著性问题上关注选民利益
AI.method: 利用世行消费数据库和精细化关税数据，分析高消费食品的关税水平
AI.findings: 高消费食品作为政治显著性基础商品享受更低关税，尤其在低收入民主国家中效果更为明显
AI.theory_contributions: 完善了民主响应性理论，提出政治显著性的调节作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解民主国家贸易政策推行提供了新视角，帮助预测不同商品的关税政策

title: Organization Capital and Corporate Biodiversity Risk: Evidence from China
affiliations: Xiamen University

detail.title: Organization Capital and Corporate Biodiversity Risk: Evidence from China
detail.abstract: We examine whether firms with high organizational capital (OC) exhibit greater corporate biodiversity risk, using a panel of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2021. We document a robust and economically meaningful positive association between OC and a firm-level biodiversity exposure index. The effect remains after controlling for firm characteristics and high-dimensional fixed effects, and after addressing endogeneity with multiple identification strategies. We propose two economic channels through which OC affects biodiversity exposure-information environment and green innovation. Consistent with these mechanisms, we find that the positive OC-biodiversity relationship is stronger for firms with superior information environments (greater analyst and media attention, higher disclosure quality, lower asymmetry) and for firms with more intensive green patenting activity. Further cross-sectional analyses show that this effect is concentrated in privately owned firms, in biodiversity-sensitive industries, in provinces with stricter environmental regulation, in more competitive product markets, and among firms with stronger boards and greater financial slack. Our results are robust to alternative model specifications, propensity score matching, instrumental-variable estimators, and the Heckman two-stage model. Overall, the findings highlight OC as a critical internal driver of nature-related risk recognition and disclosure, particularly in an emerging-market setting where biodiversity risk is particularly relevant.

AI.tldr: 研究发现组织资本高的企业面临更大的生物多样性风险，这种关系通过信息环境和绿色创新两个机制发挥作用，且在私营企业、生物多样性敏感行业等情境下更为显著
AI.research_question: 具有高组织资本的企业是否表现出更大的企业生物多样性风险
AI.motivation: 探讨组织资本如何影响企业对生物多样性风险的识别和披露，特别是在新兴市场背景下生物多样性风险日益重要的环境中
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织资本理论、企业环境责任理论、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 使用2009-2021年中国A股上市公司面板数据，采用高维固定效应模型，运用多种识别策略解决内生性问题
AI.findings: 组织资本与生物多样性风险暴露指数存在显著正相关关系，这种关系通过信息环境和绿色创新两个渠道发挥作用
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将组织资本与生物多样性风险联系起来，提出了信息环境和绿色创新两个作用机制，丰富了组织资本理论在环境风险管理中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业识别和管理生物多样性风险提供了实践指导，为监管机构制定环境政策提供了参考依据

title: Controlling Complex Contagions
affiliations: University of New South Wales (UNSW) and University of Cambridge

detail.title: Controlling Complex Contagions
detail.abstract: Many social and economic behaviors—from the adoption of new technologies or cultural norms, to protest participation—require social reinforcement to spread. That is, agents take an action if and only if enough of their neighbors in a network do so too. These phenomena are called complex contagions. However, deriving comparatives statics in model of these behaviors has proven elusive, which has rendered policy recommendations for network design intractable. We introduce a new approach by analyzing complex contagions on random graphs. This approach unlocks powerful comparative statics that allow for precise policy recommendations. We find that equilibrium behavior jumps discontinuously from zero at a critical cutoff in network connectivity, and exhibits diminishing returns thereafter. Optimal network design reveals a "missing middle" in the designer's optimal choice: network connectivity is either set at the critical cutoff or substantially above it. Finally, we discuss a number of interventions that a principal can use to control complex contagions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析随机网络上的复杂传染现象，发现网络连通性存在临界阈值，均衡行为在此处发生不连续跳跃，并呈现收益递减特性。最优网络设计呈现"缺失中间"现象，网络连通性要么设定在临界阈值，要么远高于该值。
AI.research_question: 如何在网络设计中推导复杂传染行为的比较静态分析，以提供精确的政策建议？
AI.motivation: 许多社会经济行为需要社会强化才能传播，但现有模型难以推导比较静态分析，导致网络设计的政策建议难以实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂传染理论、随机图理论、网络连通性分析
AI.method: 在随机图上分析复杂传染现象，运用网络连通性临界阈值和均衡行为分析
AI.findings: 1) 均衡行为在网络连通性临界阈值处发生不连续跳跃；2) 超过临界值后呈现收益递减特性；3) 最优网络设计呈现"缺失中间"现象
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析复杂传染的新方法，解锁了强大的比较静态分析能力，为网络设计理论提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了精确的网络设计建议，讨论了多种控制复杂传染的干预措施

title: LEY 21.521, LA PRESTACIÓN DE SERVICIOS FINANCIEROS FINTECH: EL DESAFIO DE LA COMISIÓN PARA EL MERCADO FINANCIERO PARA REGULARLOS (Act N°21.521/2023, The Provision Of Financial Services In Fintech: The Challenge For The Financial Market Comission To Regulate Them)
affiliations: Universidad Autonoma de Chile

detail.title: LEY 21.521, LA PRESTACIÓN DE SERVICIOS FINANCIEROS FINTECH: EL DESAFIO DE LA COMISIÓN PARA EL MERCADO FINANCIERO PARA REGULARLOS (Act N°21.521/2023, The Provision Of Financial Services In Fintech: The Challenge For The Financial Market Comission To Regulate Them)
detail.abstract:
Spanish Abstract: El presente trabajo tiene la finalidad de describir y evaluar, dentro de la ley N° 21.521, cuales son las empresas Fintech afectadas a esta norma legal, como se ven afectadas por la nueva regulación, cuales son los parámetros mínimos que deben cumplir, etc. De igual forma, es importante tener en cuenta las facultades de regulación otorgadas a la CMF; sus responsabilidades como entidad fiscalizadora de las empresas tecnológicas emergentes Fintech es suficiente o debe ser complementada por actos administrativos y la doctrina nacional como internacional.

Se buscará aclarar que sucederá con la seguridad hacía las Fintech y las personas, explicar el porque de las altas exigencias a las empresas Fintech sabiendo que existen distintas variables como, mantener la responsabilidad del empresario de responder y ser sancionado, que se permita la creación de futuros emprendimientos al igual que dar espacio a la responsabilidad conjunta existente del sistema financiero; ya que, no es sustentable un sistema de préstamos sin la existencia de seguros de las instituciones, con la finalidad de dar seguridad económica tanto a la institución como a las personas que ocupan los servicios prestados por las mismas.

Cabe destacar la posible discusión de cuál es la mejor forma en que debe actuar la CMF, frente a dicha problemática nos centraremos en su futuro actuar -de acuerdo con lo establecido en la ley del plazo de 18 meses desde promulgada y posteriormente- para mantener un equilibrio entre la economía de mercado y el respeto por las normas jurídicas vigentes. Sin olvidar el derecho comparado que por medio de la historia de la ley se demuestra su importancia para crearse la ley N° 21.521/2023.

English Abstract: The purpose of this paper is to describe and assess, within Act 21.521/2023, which Fintech companies are subject to this legal provision, how they are affected by the new regulation, what mínimum parameters they must meet, and so on. Likewise, it is important to take into account the regulatory powers granted to the FMC, its responsibilities as a supervisory entity for emerging Fintech technology companies, the scope of activity of these companies, whether the legal description of Fintech companies is sufficient or should by supplemented by administrative acts and both national and international doctrine.

The aim is to clarify what will happen with the security of Fintech companies and individuals, explain the reason behind the high demands placed on Fintech companies given the existence of different variables, such as maintaining the entrepreneur's responsibility to respond and be sanctioned, allowing the creation of future ventures, as well as providing space for the shared responsibility that exists within the financial system. This is because a lending system without institutional insurance is unsustainable, as such insurance is essential to provide economic security both to the institution and to the people who use its services.

It is worth highlighting the potencial debate on the best way for the FMC to act in this matter. Faced with this issue, we will focus on its future actions -according to the provisions in the law, which establishes a period of 18 months from its enactment and thereafter- to maintain a balance between the market economy and respect for the existing legal framework. This is without overlooking comparative law, which, through the legislative history, demonstrates its importance in the creation of Act 21.521/2023.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了智利第21.521/2023号法律对金融科技公司的监管影响，探讨了金融市场监管局(CMF)的监管职责、金融科技公司合规要求以及如何在市场经济发展与法律规范之间保持平衡。
AI.research_question: 智利第21.521/2023号法律对金融科技公司产生了哪些监管影响？金融市场监管局(CMF)的监管职责是否足够？如何平衡市场经济发展与法律规范之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 随着金融科技行业的快速发展，智利出台了新的监管法律，需要评估该法律对金融科技公司的影响以及监管机构的职责是否充分，确保金融系统的稳定性和用户安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融监管理论、比较法学和行政法理论，分析金融科技监管的法律框架和监管机构的职责范围。
AI.method: 采用法律文本分析、比较法研究和监管政策评估的方法，分析第21.521/2023号法律的具体条款和实施影响。
AI.findings: 新法律对金融科技公司提出了较高的合规要求，CMF需要平衡监管职责与市场发展，监管框架需要行政法令和国际学说的补充完善。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了金融科技监管的理论研究，为新兴技术公司的监管提供了法律分析框架，推动了比较法在金融监管领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技公司提供合规指导，为监管机构制定实施细则提供参考，促进智利金融科技行业的健康发展。

title: Interest and Performances of HIV Whole Genome Next‐Generation Sequencing in a Diagnosis Laboratory
affiliations: European University Institute and World Trade Organization (WTO)

detail.title: Interest and Performances of HIV Whole Genome Next‐Generation Sequencing in a Diagnosis Laboratory
detail.abstract: Large-scale movement of animals through trade can spread diseases to places where theyare not endemic. We identify the causal e ect of global livestock trade on the spread ofinfectious animal diseases through an exogenous increase in demand for imported livestock.The instrumental variable approach exploits an increase in halal livestock importsin Muslim countries during the major religious festival of Eid al-Adha. Using monthlydata for 123 countries, ve livestock categories, and sixteen years, we nd an imports-toinfectionselasticity of about 0.75. The relationship is stronger for countries that are likelyto import infected livestock from their partners, or that are endowed with large domesticlivestock. These results highlight transmission through trade from origin to destination.

AI.tldr: 通过利用埃德节期期间哈拉畜牧进口需求增加作为外生变量，证实了全球畜牧贸易对动物传染病传播的因果效应，进口与感染问题弹性系数约为0.75
AI.research_question: 全球畜牧贸易是否以及如何导致动物传染病在非流行区的传播？
AI.motivation: 大规模动物贸易可能会将疾病传播到非流行区，需要证实贸易与疾病传播间的因果关系
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易与疾病传播理论，使用埃德节期期间哈拉畜牧进口需求增加作为外生变量进行差分识别
AI.method: 差分识别方法，利用埃德节期期间哈拉畜牧进口需求增加作为外生变量，分析123个国家、5种畜牧类别、16年的月度数据
AI.findings: 进口与感染问题弹性系数约为0.75，这种关系在可能从伙伴国进口已感染畜牧或本国畜牧业规模较大的国家中更为显著
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了贸易与疾病传播关系的因果性证据，为全球公共卫生和动物健康政策提供理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 给畜牧贸易监管和疾病防控提供政策建议，特别是在宗教节日期间加强进口畜牧的健康检疫

title: Digital Transformation and Global Trade: Opportunities and Challenges for Emerging Economies
affiliations: University of Hertfordshire

detail.title: Digital Transformation and Global Trade: Opportunities and Challenges for Emerging Economies
detail.abstract: Digital globalization has transformed the landscape of international business, reshaping trade flows, investment patterns, and cross-border collaboration. For emerging economies like India, the acceleration of digital technologies presents both opportunities and challenges. This article critically examines the implications of digital globalization for India in the coming decade. Drawing on recent reports from the World Bank, UNCTAD, and leading scholars, the paper highlights key opportunities in e-commerce expansion, digital services exports, innovation ecosystems, and global value chains. At the same time, it considers the challenges of digital inequality, cybersecurity threats, regulatory gaps, and geopolitical uncertainties. The discussion emphasizes how India can position itself strategically by investing in digital infrastructure, upskilling human capital, fostering entrepreneurship, and strengthening policy frameworks. Ultimately, the article argues that India stands at a pivotal moment: by leveraging digital globalization effectively, it can enhance its role as a major player in international business and drive inclusive economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字全球化对印度未来十年的影响，分析其在电子商务、数字服务出口、创新生态系统和全球价值链方面的机遇，以及数字不平等、网络安全威胁、监管缺口和地缘政治不确定性等挑战，并提出印度应通过投资数字基础设施、提升人力资本、培育创业精神和加强政策框架来把握机遇。
AI.research_question: 数字全球化对印度未来十年在国际商务中的机遇和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字全球化正在重塑国际贸易、投资和跨境合作格局，对印度这样的新兴经济体既带来机遇也带来挑战，需要系统分析其影响和应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字全球化理论、国际商务理论和新兴经济体发展理论，结合世界银行、UNCTAD等机构的报告和学者研究成果。
AI.method: 文献分析法，综合世界银行、UNCTAD报告和学者研究成果进行批判性分析。
AI.findings: 数字全球化为印度带来电子商务扩张、数字服务出口增长、创新生态系统发展和全球价值链整合等机遇，但同时也面临数字不平等、网络安全威胁、监管缺口和地缘政治不确定性等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字全球化对新兴经济体影响的理论研究，提供了印度案例的具体分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政府和企业提供了具体的战略建议，包括投资数字基础设施、提升人力资本、培育创业精神和加强政策框架，以把握数字全球化机遇。

title: When Roll-up Breaks: Serial Private Equity Acquisitions in the Hospital Industry
affiliations: Duke University - Finance

detail.title: When Roll-up Breaks: Serial Private Equity Acquisitions in the Hospital Industry
detail.abstract: This paper challenges the idea that private equity (PE) roll-ups consistently create site-level operating value across sequential acquisitions. I link hospital operations, finances, quality, and deal data and classify targets as stand-alone, platform, or add-on. Platforms are selected from low-leverage, higher-margin hospitals, consistent with grandstanding at entry. They obtain cheaper debt at close, rebalance balance sheets and investment, and then exhibit gradual profitability gains. Add-ons inherit the platform facility, cut headcount, and do not generate additional margin improvement. The evidence points to a two-stage strategy, with value created at platform formation and little scalability to add-on acquisitions in the hospital industry.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了私募股权滚动收购能持续创造运营价值的观点，通过对医院行业的研究发现价值主要在平台形成阶段创造，附加收购几乎不产生额外边际改善
AI.research_question: 私募股权滚动收购是否能在医院行业的连续收购中持续创造站点层面的运营价值？
AI.motivation: 挑战私募股权滚动收购能持续创造运营价值的传统观点，揭示医院行业PE收购的真实价值创造机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 私募股权价值创造理论、滚动收购策略理论、医院运营管理理论
AI.method: 链接医院运营、财务、质量和交易数据，将目标医院分类为独立医院、平台医院和附加医院进行对比分析
AI.findings: 平台医院从低杠杆、高利润医院中挑选，获得更便宜的债务，重新平衡资产负债表和投资，逐步实现盈利能力提升；附加医院继承平台设施，削减人员，但不产生额外边际改善
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了PE滚动收购的两阶段价值创造模型，修正了传统认为滚动收购能持续创造规模效应的理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为医院行业投资者和管理者提供了PE收购策略的实际效果评估，揭示了平台形成阶段的价值创造机会和附加收购的局限性

title: Project Valuation under Dual-Source Risk in Incomplete Markets: An Axiomatic Framework
affiliations: School of Business, Southern University of Science and Technology, China, Colorado State University, Fort Collins - Department of Finance & Real Estate and University of Texas at Austin

detail.title: Project Valuation under Dual-Source Risk in Incomplete Markets: An Axiomatic Framework
detail.abstract: This paper develops a unified axiomatic framework for valuing risky projects in incomplete markets where uncertainty arises from both market-traded and privately held sources. By integrating decision analysis and finance valuation approaches, we theoretically examine how the sequencing of market and private uncertainty resolutions affects valuation outcomes. Challenging the commonly held assumption of valuation order independence justified by independence or Bayesian updating in standard decision analysis, our analysis reveals that reversing the order of uncertainty resolution can materially alter valuations involving intertwined market and private risks under market incompleteness. To identify normatively robust valuation models, we propose a set of axioms and theories that formalize rational preference conditions across diverse informational structures. We further extend the framework to dynamic settings, demonstrating its consistency with mean-variance preferences and its applicability to multiperiod portfolio management. The resulting framework offers both a rigorous theoretical foundation and actionable guidance for practitioners evaluating complex investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文为不完全市场中风险项目估值建立了统一的公理化框架，整合了决策分析和金融估值方法，揭示了市场与私人不确定性解决顺序对估值结果的重要影响，挑战了传统估值顺序独立性假设。
AI.research_question: 在不完全市场中，市场交易风险和私人持有风险的解决顺序如何影响风险项目的估值结果？
AI.motivation: 传统决策分析中基于独立性或贝叶斯更新的估值顺序独立性假设在实际不完全市场环境中可能不成立，需要建立更严谨的理论框架来处理交织的市场和私人风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合决策分析和金融估值理论的统一公理化框架，基于理性偏好条件的形式化公理体系。
AI.method: 理论分析方法，通过公理化框架和数学建模来探讨不确定性解决顺序对估值的影响，并扩展到动态设置和均值-方差偏好的一致性验证。
AI.findings: 市场不完全性下，市场风险和私人风险的解决顺序反转会显著改变估值结果，挑战了传统的估值顺序独立性假设。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了处理不完全市场中交织风险估值的统一公理化框架，建立了跨不同信息结构的理性偏好条件形式化理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者评估复杂投资决策提供了严谨的理论基础和可操作的指导，特别是在多期投资组合管理中的应用。

title: Executing trades in style: Retail investors vs. institutions
affiliations: Chulalongkorn University - Department of Banking & Finance, Chulalongkorn University - Chulalongkorn Business School and University of Luxembourg

detail.title: Executing trades in style: Retail investors vs. institutions
detail.abstract: Employing an exhaustive sample of trades made by all investors in a fully automated order-driven stock market, we examine trade execution prices between retail and institutional investors. Retail investors execute both purchases and sales systematically at better prices than domestic institutions, but receive better prices than foreign institutions only when executing sales. Importantly, we also find some evidence consistent with the hypothesis that retail investors have a comparative advantage in executing trades of small-cap stocks. Based on a population of retail trades, our findings are not consistent with the stereotype arising from earlier studies that retail investors are noise traders.

title: Intraday Proprietary Traders and Short-term Mispricing*
affiliations: Indian School of Business, Indian School of Business, Indian School of Business and Indian School of Business

detail.title: Intraday Proprietary Traders and Short-term Mispricing*
detail.abstract: Whose trading corrects temporary mispricing? We document that intraday proprietary traders play this crucial role. Using trader-level transaction data, we examine the activities of different types of traders around a media-driven, clean shock to retail trading. Intraday proprietary traders are contrarian and contribute to an immediate and sustained price correction. Their trades generate returns from informed trading rather than liquidity provision. Conversely, longer-term proprietary traders who engage in much less contrarian trading make small returns from liquidity provision, not informed trading. Thus, policies designed to curb short-termism must account for the contributions of different types of traders to price discovery.

AI.tldr: 日内自营交易者通过逆向交易纠正临时错误定价，贡献价格发现；而长期交易者主要通过流动性提供获利。政策制定需区分不同类型交易者的作用。
AI.research_question: 哪种类型的交易者能够纠正临时错误定价？
AI.motivation: 理解不同类型交易者在价格发现过程中的作用，特别是面对媒体驱动的零售交易冲击时的反应
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、行为金融学、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 使用交易者级别的交易数据，分析媒体驱动的零售交易冲击期间不同类型交易者的活动
AI.findings: 日内自营交易者采取逆向交易策略，立即且持续地纠正价格偏差，通过信息交易获利；长期自营交易者逆向交易较少，主要通过流动性提供获得小额收益
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了不同类型交易者在价格发现中的差异化作用，挑战了传统对短期交易的负面看法

title: Wavelet Analysis and the Financial Performance of ESG-Strategies
affiliations: University of Applied Sciences Darmstadt

detail.title: Wavelet Analysis and the Financial Performance of ESG-Strategies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted for Handbook of ESG Investing

detail.abstract: This study examines the relationship between Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) information and financial performance in Europe using wavelet-based multiresolution analysis. By combining an event study approach with the Maximal Overlap Discrete Wavelet Transform (MODWT), the analysis isolates reactions to ESG-related signals and captures the temporal structure of abnormal returns. ESG signals are derived from price movements of STOXX Global ESG Leaders indices, and portfolios are constructed based on top and bottom LSEG Refinitiv ESG ratings. The results indicate that ESG effects are not short-lived but develop over medium-to long-term horizons. Environmental and social signals are gradually incorporated into asset prices under stable market conditions, while governance-related effects are more volatile and pronounced in poorly rated firms. The study contributes a novel methodological perspective by linking signal-driven performance responses with the time-frequency characteristics of returns, offering insights into the persistence of ESG information and the timing relevance of its market impact.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用小波多分辨率分析探讨欧洲市场ESG信息与财务表现的关系，发现ESG效应具有中长期持续性，环境和社会信号在稳定市场条件下逐步融入资产价格，而治理效应在低评级公司中更显著且波动。
AI.research_question: ESG信息与财务绩效之间的关系如何？ESG效应的时间特征和持续性如何？
AI.motivation: 理解ESG信息对金融市场的影响机制，特别是其时间维度和持续性特征，为投资者和决策者提供更精准的ESG投资策略依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有效市场假说和行为金融理论，结合信号理论和信息传递机制，分析ESG信息如何影响资产定价和市场反应。
AI.method: 采用小波多分辨率分析（MODWT）结合事件研究方法，从STOXX Global ESG Leaders指数价格变动中提取ESG信号，构建基于LSEG Refinitiv ESG评级的投资组合。
AI.findings: ESG效应具有中长期持续性；环境和社会信号在稳定市场条件下逐步融入价格；治理相关效应在低评级公司中更显著且波动性更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将信号驱动的绩效响应与收益的时频特征相结合的新方法框架，深化了对ESG信息持续性和市场影响时机相关性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供ESG投资时机选择的实践指导，帮助识别不同ESG维度在不同市场条件下的投资价值，提升ESG投资策略的有效性。

title: The importance of targets and value creation in vertical acquisitions
affiliations: Chulalongkorn University - Department of Banking & Finance and University of Strathclyde

detail.title: The importance of targets and value creation in vertical acquisitions
detail.abstract: We study how value creation in vertical acquisitions varies in the importance of the target’s assets to its acquirer. The synergistic gain increases in the degree of vertical relatedness between the acquirer and target industries. This finding suggests that the importance of the target firm’s assets to its acquirer’s productivity is an important value-creating channel in vertical acquisitions. We also find evidence suggesting that acquirers extract greater value as the synergistic gain increases, consistent with an efficient investment incentive underlying the integration decision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究纵向收购中价值创造如何随目标资产对收购方的重要性而变化，发现协同收益随行业纵向关联度增加而增加，表明目标资产对收购方生产率的重要性是重要价值创造渠道，且收购方在协同收益增加时能获取更大价值

AI.method: 实证研究方法，分析纵向关联度与协同收益的关系

title: Generalized Bayesian subset simulation for the evaluation of failure probability
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Generalized Bayesian subset simulation for the evaluation of failure probability
detail.abstract: Evaluation of failure probability is essential in system design and analysis. But it has become increasing prohibitive due to growing system complexity and soaring simulation costs. To address such challenge, we propose a novel active learning framework, the generalized Bayesian subset simulation (GBSS), to estimate failure probability. Based on the concept of generalized subset simulation, GBSS introduces a novel threshold-first criteria and decomposes the target failure events into an optimal sequence of intermediate events. Combined with a Bayesian surrogate model, high-quality conditional samples may be generated efficiently with residual resampling in Markov chain Monte Carlo and in turn improves model accuracy. We evaluate our framework via a comprehensive set of academic examples and industrial cases of high dimensions. Comparing to four state-of-the-art methods, including Monte Carlo, subset simulation, generalized subset simulation and multi-fidelity subset simulations, GBSS demonstrates substantial improvements in both numerical efficiency and stability.

AI.tldr: 提出了广义贝叶斯子集模拟（GBSS）方法，通过引入阈值优先准则和贝叶斯代理模型，有效解决高复杂度系统失效概率评估的计算成本问题，在数值效率和稳定性方面显著优于现有方法。

AI.motivation: 系统复杂性增加和仿真成本飙升使得失效概率评估变得越来越困难，需要开发更高效的算法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于广义子集模拟理论，结合贝叶斯推断和马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛方法。
AI.method: 提出GBSS框架，采用阈值优先准则将目标失效事件分解为最优中间事件序列，结合贝叶斯代理模型和残差重采样技术。
AI.findings: 在学术案例和高维工业案例中，GBSS相比蒙特卡洛、子集模拟、广义子集模拟和多保真度子集模拟等四种先进方法，在数值效率和稳定性方面都有显著提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了广义贝叶斯子集模拟的理论框架，发展了阈值优先准则和条件采样优化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为复杂系统设计分析提供了高效的失效概率评估工具，可显著降低计算成本和提高评估准确性。

title: Trump strikes again! Will geopolitical fragmentation be different?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, National Bank of Poland and National Bank of Poland

detail.title: Trump strikes again! Will geopolitical fragmentation be different?
detail.abstract: We examine trade effects of US tariff increases introduced by Donald Trump by May 2025, using a New Quantitative Trade model calibrated to 45 countries and 56 industries. In addition to scenarios based on official announcements, we analyze one scenario that incorporates actual changes in effective US tariff rates for detailed product categories. We separate the roles of tariff hikes, exemptions, and retaliation in driving changes in key macroeconomic variables. Our findings indicate that the tariff shock acts as like a negative supply shock for the US, and as a demand shock for its major partners. Tariff-driven trade adjustments reinforce geoeconomic fragmentation, particularly within the Western bloc.

AI.tldr: 本文使用新量化贸易模型分析特朗普关税政策的影响，发现美国关税冲击对本国类似负面供给冲击，对主要伙伴则类似需求冲击，并加剧了西方集团内部的地缘经济分裂。

AI.motivation: 量化分析特朗普关税政策的实际影响，分离关税上调、豁免和报复在宏观经济变量变化中的作用

AI.method: 基于45个国家和56个行业的校准模型，分析官方公告情景和实际有效关税变化情景

title: Handing Over the Keys to the City: When Governments May Inadvertently Solve One Crisis with a Bigger One
affiliations: University of Cambridge, University of Cambridge, University of Cologne and Cornell University - College of Arts & Sciences

detail.title: Handing Over the Keys to the City: When Governments May Inadvertently Solve One Crisis with a Bigger One

keywords: Handing Over the Keys to the City

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the concept of "handing over the keys to the city", whereby political leaders facing severe crises delegate (potentially excessive) decision-making authority and/or operational control to external entities perceived as holding indispensable solutions. While intended to resolve the initial crisis, this delegation has the potential to inadvertently create larger, more intractable problems, and the desperation felt during a crisis can push leaders into Faustian pacts, trading control for perceived salvation. We develop a conceptual framework to analyse situations where governments hand over the keys to the city, presenting typologies for different crises, the types of key that can be delegated, and the extent to which such delegation(s) can occur. We conclude by drawing out the policy implications, and outlining a research agenda.

detail.title: A Data-Driven Stochastic Multi-Objective Framework for Sustainable Oil-Palm Seed Distribution: Scenario, Sensitivity, and Robustness Analytics
detail.abstract: ABTRACTThe distribution of oil palm seedlings (KKS) plays a strategic role in the sustainability of the plantation system but is faced with budget constraints, variations in distribution costs, and inter-regional disparities. This study develops a data driven multiobjective stochastic optimization framework to balance three main dimensions involve coverage, equity, and cost efficiency. Utilizing historical KKS distribution data and designing baseline, high-cost, and low-budget scenarios, this study formulates three approaches: a deterministic model as the baseline, a two-stage risk-neutral (RN) stochastic optimization, and a riskaverse (RA) expansion using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). The results indicate that the RN model is able to increase national coverage by 0.72 but results in higher inequality by 0.11. Conversely, the RA model reduces inequality by 0.09 with a relatively small decrease in coverage by 0.70 and better cost control. Sensitivity analysis confirms that indicator weights and policy targets strongly influence coverage, while risk penalties have a greater influence on inequality. Under extreme scenarios of cost increases, budget cuts, and decreased efficiency, robustness tests demonstrate that RA is more stable, equitable, and efficient than RN. Beyond KKS distribution, this approach can be applied to other resource allocation systems to support equitable, efficient, and resilient plantation policies.

detail.abstract: In this chapter, we analyse the impact of corruption on the environment in Ukraine. Ukraine is an ideal case study for the effects of corruption on the environment having been part of the Soviet Union and suffering a catastrophic environmental disaster in part due to the systematic corruption of that state. Post-independence Ukraine continues to struggle with corruption, despite some significant progress. Moreover, the full-scale Russian invasion of 2022, launched by a kleptocratic regime and implemented by a corrupt military, has devasted Ukraine's environment and poses an ongoing threat to the global environment. We analyse data from interviews conducted in 2024 and 2025 with members of Ukrainian civil society involved in environmental activism, experts in environmental law and environmental protection, and with experience in the community and state sector relating to the environment. Based on the analysis of these data, we describe Ukrainians' assessment of the impact of corruption on the environment, the dynamics of the fight against corruption in the 21 st century and the factors that have influenced it. We highlight the most common manifestations of corruption that our respondents have encountered, as well as their assessment of the impact of the war on the spread of corruption. We summarise respondents' opinions on effective ways to combat corruption in the environmental sector. The chapter therefore provides insights into corruption patterns and potential anti-corruption strategies to protect the environment.

detail.abstract: A frozen embryo does not merely represent a potential for human life; it represents a deferred decision to trigger this potential. Parties value this decision deferral because it allows them to retain the option to attempt conception after any uncertainty about future events or desires has resolved. Failing to recognize this “option value” of embryos has resulted in confusion over the best approach to allocating ownership of embryos and calculating damages for reproductive harms. This Article provides a novel paradigm showing that embryos should be treated as neither persons nor mere property; instead, a significant portion of their value is in their ability to preserve and defer decisions over implantation. When such embryonic option-hood is overlooked, society risks improperly allocating disposition rights and undercompensating patients who were deprived of this option. Given this insight, this Article makes two significant contributions. First, this Article proposes a modified approach to embryo disposition that validates—rather than undermines—the option value of embryos. In the absence of a valid contract, most courts balance party interests at the time of conflict. Because this approach is not focused on party expectations at the time of embryo creation, reliance on the traditional balancing test can essentially destroy the option value of embryos. This Article adds an intermediate step before resorting to balancing which requires the court to make a fact-intensive determination into whether there was an agreed-upon disposition at the time of embryo creation. In the absence of evidence of original intent, the Article proposes a modified version of the traditional balancing test courts have used. Second, acknowledging the option value of embryos sheds light on how to calculate damages in different contexts. This Article establishes a methodology for determining both the standard of care/regulatory standards necessary to protect embryos as well as damages for compensating patients for negligence resulting in embryo loss and for intentional interference with embryos. The Article concludes by cautioning that state interference newly allowed by Dobbs can eviscerate the option value of embryos, with upstream effects for embryo creation and fertility care access.

title: Ethical, Legal, and Social Issues (ELSI) in the Conversion of Existing Airport Facilities to Spaceports
affiliations: Keio University, Chiba University - Chiba University Hospital, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Ethical, Legal, and Social Issues (ELSI) in the Conversion of Existing Airport Facilities to Spaceports
detail.abstract: This study conducts a systematic literature review to identify and analyze the ethical, legal, and social issues (ELSI) associated with converting airports into spaceports. Using seven academic databases, 343 records were screened, and 17 studies were selected for detailed analysis. Ten key ELSI categories were extracted, including economic impact, pollution, sonic booms, aviation disruption, safety, public health, and insurance. While many issues are broadly relevant to spaceports, some, such as cost-effectiveness and airspace management, are specific to airport-to-spaceport conversion. To contextualize the findings, Oita Airport in Japan was analyzed as a case study. Two projects were reviewed: a satellite launch project (since canceled) and an ongoing spaceplane landing plan. Oita Airport’s coastal location, low air traffic, and existing infrastructure make it suitable for spaceport use, although its lack of medical facilities remains a concern. The study concludes that airports suitable for conversion should (1) be located away from densely populated areas, (2) have low interference with existing aviation operations, and (3) possess or be connected to sufficient medical infrastructure. The analysis underscores the need for a cost-benefit approach when evaluating public investments in such projects, especially considering potential disruptions to aviation and the need for public accountability. The paper highlights gaps in the current literature, such as the absence of empirical data and lack of regulatory clarity, and recommends future research focused on stakeholder engagement, implementation feedback, and the development of standardized ELSI frameworks for emerging spaceports.

detail.abstract:
Italian abstract: Le conseguenze sulle economie locali di crisi industriali e chiusure di stabilimenti che occupano una quota rilevante di manodopera sono state oggetto di un interesse relativamente recente da parte della letteratura. Applicando il metodo del controllo sintetico ad un evento che ha interessato un’area del Sud Italia specializzata nella produzione di autoveicoli se ne quantificano gli effetti economici di lungo periodo sul territorio interessato. La chiusura dello stabilimento FIAT di Termini Imerese ha ridotto in maniera persistente il livello e il tasso di occupazione, determinando una diminuzione della popolazione in età da lavoro, un calo del reddito disponibile e delle quotazioni immobiliari.

English abstract: The consequences for local economies of industrial crises and the closure of plants employing a large share of the workforce have only recently attracted attention in the literature. This study quantifies the long-term economic effects of an event that occurred in an area of Southern Italy specializing in motor vehicle production, by applying the synthetic control method. The closure of the FIAT plant in Termini Imerese (Sicily) has persistently lowered the employment level and rate, leading to a decline in the working-age population, disposable income and house prices.

title: Is Quad Graphics Decision Innocuous or a Jurisprudential Threat?

detail.title: Is Quad Graphics Decision Innocuous or a Jurisprudential Threat?
detail.abstract:
Professor Pomp criticizes the North Carolina Supreme Court decision in Quad Graphics Inc. v. N.C. Dep't of Revenue. Professor Pomp critically examines the broader implications of this decision, especially the North Carolina Supreme Court's overruling Supreme Court precedent. Specifically, the state court interpreted Complete Auto and Wayfair as overruling Dilworth, even though Dilworth had not been overruled explicitly by the Supreme Court. 

This article argues that viewing Dilworth as having been overruled also ignores decisions after Dilworth, such as National Geographic and Jefferson Lines. These cases reaffirmed Dilworth and ignored the lower court's claim that Complete Auto implicitly rejected the formalistic distinction between sales and use taxes. Professor Pomp notes that Wayfair did not cite Dilworth, which the North Carolina court nonetheless viewed as Wayfair implicitly overruling Dilworth. Professor Pomp explains how the lower court did not appreciate the litigating posture in Wayfair, which would have made a Dilworth argument an unnecessary distraction and delay.

If lower courts can overturn Supreme Court precedent on their own, chaos will result as fifty states may have inconsistent views. Quad Graphics may embolden states to test the boundaries of their taxing power in a manner that conflicts with existing Supreme Court precedent, creating uncertainty and upsetting reliance interests.

AI.tldr: 本文批判北卡罗来纳州最高法院在Quad Graphics案中的判决，认为该法院错误地将Complete Auto和Wayfair案解释为推翻了Dilworth先例，但实际上最高法院并未明确推翻Dilworth，且后续案例如National Geographic和Jefferson Lines都重申了Dilworth原则。
AI.research_question: 北卡罗来纳州最高法院是否正确解释了最高法院在Complete Auto和Wayfair案中对Dilworth先例的处理？

detail.abstract: This study investigates the challenges associated with the marketing and processing of locally produced rice, with a particular focus on processors in Ivo Local Government Area (LGA) of Ebonyi State, Nigeria. The specific objectives were to: examine the effects of taxes on rice marketing and processing, evaluate the impact of transportation costs on rice sales and processing, and assess the influence of technological advancements on rice marketing and processing. A survey research design was adopted, and data were collected using structured questionnaires administered to rice processors. Descriptive statistics and regression analysis, supported by the Statistical Package for Social Sciences (SPSS) Version 25, were employed to analyze the data. To strengthen the strategic evaluation, SWOT and PESTEL analytical frameworks were also applied. The findings revealed that multiple levies, high transportation expenses, and limited technological innovations significantly constrain rice processing and marketing in the study area (p < 0.05). The study recommends reducing taxation through policy reforms, improving transport infrastructure to ease logistics costs, and promoting technological adoption via equipment subsidies and capacity-building initiatives. These measures are critical for enhancing the competitiveness, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness of rice processing and marketing, thereby contributing to local food security and rural economic development.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了尼日利亚Ebonyi州Ivo地区本地大米营销和加工面临的挑战，发现多重税收、高昂运输成本和有限技术创新是主要制约因素，建议通过政策改革、基础设施改善和技术推广来提升竞争力。

title: The impact of Trichodiniosis on carp larvae under climate change
affiliations: Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură, Dunarea de Jos University of Galati, Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură, Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Institutul de Cercetare-Dezvoltare pentru Ecologie Acvatică, Pescuit și Acvacultură

detail.title: The impact of Trichodiniosis on carp larvae under climate change
detail.abstract: Recent climate changes, particularly rising temperatures, contribute to pond water eutrophication. This process leads to increased ectoparasite populations and decreased carp larvae and post-larvae production in fish farms. This study aims to analyze the correlation between the level of Trichodiniosis parasitism in carp larvae and various factors, including temperature, water chemistry, and hydrobiology, over three years in four carp breeding ponds. The results demonstrate a proportional relationship between rising water temperature, organic matter content, algal biomass, and the incidence of Trichodina sp. parasitism in carp larvae.

AI.tldr: 本文研究气候变化导致水温上升对鲤鱼养殖的影响，发现水温升高与有机质含量、藻类生物量增加相关，进而导致鲤鱼幼虫中Trichodina寄生虫感染率上升。
AI.research_question: 鲤鱼幼虫中Trichodiniosis寄生虫感染水平与温度、水化学和水生生物学因素之间的相关性是什么？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化对水生生态系统影响的理论框架，特别是温度升高导致水体富营养化和寄生虫种群动态变化的理论。
AI.method: 在四个鲤鱼养殖池塘进行了为期三年的研究，分析了Trichodiniosis寄生虫感染水平与温度、水化学和水生生物学因素的相关性。
AI.findings: 研究结果表明，水温上升、有机质含量增加和藻类生物量增加与鲤鱼幼虫中Trichodina sp.寄生虫感染发生率呈正比例关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为气候变化对水产养殖中寄生虫-宿主关系的影响提供了实证证据，丰富了水温变化对寄生虫种群动态影响的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为鲤鱼养殖业提供了重要的管理启示，建议通过控制水温、减少有机质积累和藻类过度生长来降低寄生虫感染风险，提高养殖产量。

title: Research Outcomes in the Field of Aquaculture and Fisheries During the 2020–2024 Period at the National Institute for Research and Development in Aquatic Ecology, Fishing and Aquaculture – Galați (I.C.D.E.A.P.A. Galați)

detail.title: Research Outcomes in the Field of Aquaculture and Fisheries During the 2020–2024 Period at the National Institute for Research and Development in Aquatic Ecology, Fishing and Aquaculture – Galați (I.C.D.E.A.P.A. Galați)
detail.abstract: The Research-Development Institute for Aquatic Ecology, Fisheries and Aquaculture in Galați is the only branch institute in Romania whose main activity is research in the field of fish farming. It operates under the provisions of Law no. 45/2009 as a public law institution organized as a public institution, with legal personality, under the subordination of the "Gheorghe Ionescu-Sişeşti" Academy of Agricultural and Forestry Sciences and H.G. no. 369/2017 supplemented by H.G. 543/2023. The Institute was established by Decree no. 33/21.02.1981, under the name "Research-Design Center for Pisciculture, Fishing and Fish  Industrialization Galați". It continued the "Institute of Fisheries Research of Romania" which operated in the period 1947-1976 in the research-development area in the field of fish farming. In the period 2020-2024, the institution has experienced a spectacular increase in the results obtained in the field of research, both due to the increase in the number of researchers and, especially, due to the involvement in an increased number of projects. At the same time, the impact at national and international level of the results obtained by the institution has increased. This material only details this trend.
