title: Relevance of PAS 41 Provisions for Davao City Agricultural Entities in the Context of Post-Covid Accounting Challenges
affiliations: University of Mindanao, University of Mindanao, University of Mindanao and University of Mindanao

detail.title: Relevance of PAS 41 Provisions for Davao City Agricultural Entities in the Context of Post-Covid Accounting Challenges

publicationDetails.detailsText: Business and Organization Studies e-Journal Vol. 1 No. 3 (2023), pp. 53-76

detail.abstract: This research investigates the awareness and compliance with the PAS 41 standard within the agricultural industries of Davao City, Philippines. The study reveals a pressing need for improvement in awareness and adherence to accounting standards attributable to the inherent complexities of agricultural operations and transactions. Using descriptive statistics and multiple regression analyses, Factors influencing compliance, including legal systems, providers of finance, taxation, national culture, and other influences, were identified and found to be perceived at a high level by agricultural entities. An analysis of the perceived relevance of PAS 41 provisions indicates that recognition and measurement provisions are highly relevant, while presentation and disclosure provisions are considered relevant. The research findings highlight a practical deviation from the theoretical framework, emphasizing the unique challenges agricultural entities face in adhering to generic accounting standards. This underscores the necessity for a balanced approach that respects standard uniformity while allowing for practical adaptability within industries with distinct operational characteristics.

AI.tldr: 这份研究调查了菲律宾道沃市农业行业对PAS 41准则的认知与遵循情况，发现农业企业存在认知不足和遵循差距，需要在标准统一性与行业特殊性之间寻找平衡。
AI.research_question: 农业企业对PAS 41会计准则的认知度和遵循情况如何？哪些因素影响农业企业的标准遵循行为？
AI.motivation: 农业运营和交易的内在复杂性导致农业企业在认知和遵循会计准则方面存在明显不足，需要改善
AI.theoretical_framework: 会计准则遵循理论，重点考虑法律系统、融资来源、税政、国家文化等因素对标准遵循的影响
AI.method: 描述统计学和多元回归分析
AI.findings: 法律系统、融资来源、税政、国家文化等因素被认为影响高；认证与计量规定高度相关，呈现与曝露规定相关性中等
AI.theory_contributions: 展现了理论框架与实践之间的差距，强调了通用会计准则在具有独特运营特征的行业中面临的挑战
AI.practical_contributions: 为农业企业提高PAS 41标准遵循提供实践指导，建议在标准统一性与实践适应性之间寻找平衡

title: LISTEN: Lightweight Industrial Sound-representable Transformer for Edge Notification
affiliations: Purdue University, Purdue University, Purdue University, Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST) and Purdue University

detail.title: LISTEN: Lightweight Industrial Sound-representable Transformer for Edge Notification
detail.abstract: Deep learning-based machine listening is broadening the scope of industrial acoustic analysis, yet its widespread implementation on live shop floors is hindered by the reliance on large, task-specific annotated datasets for every new task. While emerging general-purpose sound foundation models aim to alleviate data dependency, they reveal critical dilemmas in practice. General-purpose sound foundation models are computationally expensive and fail in industrial scenarios characterized by tonal harmonics, broadband noise, and transient fault events, making instant, on-site deployment impractical. These challenges combined mean that a practical, end-to-end system for deploying a sound foundation model on a live shop floor has remained elusive. To address this challenge, this study introduces LISTEN (Lightweight Industrial Sound-representable Transformer for Edge Notification), the first lightweight foundation model specialized for industrial sound. Through Knowledge Distillation (KD) from its large-scale parent model, IMPACT (Industrial Machine Perception via Acoustic Cognitive Transformer), LISTEN achieves nearly identical performance while being optimized for edge hardware constraints. This study further demonstrates a complete system for real-time machine monitoring, encompassing data acquisition with Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) devices, rapid model adaptation using minimal annotated data, and real-time monitoring on a low-cost edge device. By validating the entire system on a live Computerized Numerical Control (CNC) machine, this work establishes the first feasible end-to-end system for deploying a lightweight industrial sound foundation model in an active industrial environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了LISTEN（轻量级工业声音可表示变换器），这是首个专为工业声音设计的轻量化基础模型。通过知识蒸馏从大型模型IMPACT中学习，LISTEN在保持相近性能的同时优化了边缘硬件约束，并展示了完整的实时机器监控系统。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个轻量级的工业声音基础模型，使其能够在边缘设备上实时部署并有效处理工业环境中的声音分析任务？
AI.motivation: 深度学习在工业声音分析中的应用受到大规模标注数据依赖的制约，现有通用声音基础模型在工业场景中计算成本高且性能不足，无法满足实时现场部署需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识蒸馏理论，从大型基础模型向轻量化模型传递知识；结合工业声音特征（谐波、宽带噪声、瞬态故障事件）的特殊性构建专用模型架构。
AI.method: 采用知识蒸馏技术从IMPACT大型模型训练LISTEN轻量模型；使用工业物联网设备进行数据采集；基于最小标注数据进行快速模型适配；在低成本边缘设备上实现实时监控。
AI.findings: LISTEN模型在保持与大型模型相近性能的同时，显著降低了计算需求；完整的端到端系统在真实CNC机器上验证可行，实现了工业环境中的实时声音监控。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个专为工业声音设计的轻量化基础模型理论框架；建立了工业声音特征与模型架构的对应关系；拓展了知识蒸馏在工业声音分析中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了完整的实时工业机器监控系统；解决了工业现场部署的实际技术难题；为工业4.0提供了可行的声音分析解决方案；降低了工业声音分析的实施成本和技术门槛。

title: The Deep State and the Liberal Drift of Financial Regulators
affiliations: Harbert College of Business, Auburn University, University of Rochester - Simon Business School and Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business

detail.title: The Deep State and the Liberal Drift of Financial Regulators
detail.abstract: We find a strong liberal tilt in the political ideology of 4,500 Securities and Exchange Commission attorneys responsible for crafting and enforcing financial regulation. Democrats outnumber Republicans four to one and support candidates with a prominent progressive leaning. This liberal tilt expands in senior ranks, increases over time, and persists across all political regimes between 1996 and 2023. Mechanisms include feeder schools, office locations, and job preferences. Political misalignment with the SEC Commissioners increases partisan dissent in rulemaking, and misalignment with the President reduces enforcement. Overall, entrenched career attorneys represent a powerful force in financial regulation distinct from political appointees.

AI.tldr: 研究发现SEC律师团队存在明显的自由主义倾向，民主党与共和党比例为4:1，且支持进步派候选人。这种倾向在高级职位中更明显，随时间增强，并持续存在于1996-2023年所有政治体制下。机制包括招聘来源、办公地点和工作偏好。与SEC委员的政治立场不一致会增加规则制定中的党派分歧，与总统不一致会减少执法力度。
AI.research_question: SEC职业律师的政治意识形态如何影响金融监管？
AI.motivation: 理解金融监管机构中职业官僚的政治倾向及其对监管政策的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 官僚政治理论、监管俘获理论、政治意识形态对政策执行的影响
AI.method: 对4500名SEC律师的政治意识形态数据进行分析（1996-2023年）
AI.findings: SEC律师存在强烈自由主义倾向（民主党:共和党=4:1），倾向在高级职位更明显且随时间增强；政治立场不一致导致规则制定党派分歧增加和执法力度减少
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了职业官僚作为独立于政治任命官员的强大监管力量，拓展了金融监管政治经济学理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构人事管理和政治中立性提供政策启示，有助于理解金融监管决策过程中的政治因素

title: Cracking the Glass Ceiling, Tightening the Spread: The Bond Market Impacts of Board Gender Diversity
affiliations: Antai College of Economics & Management, Shanghai Jiaotong University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management

detail.title: Cracking the Glass Ceiling, Tightening the Spread: The Bond Market Impacts of Board Gender Diversity
detail.abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of board gender diversity on corporate bond financing costs. We exploit the 2017 governance campaigns by BlackRock, Vanguard, and State Street as a plausibly exogenous shock to female board representation. Using difference-indifferences estimation, we find that firms with greater campaign exposure experience significant reductions in bond yield spreads and improvements in credit ratings. We identify two key mechanisms: enhanced board gender diversity leads to lower leverage ratios and improved stakeholder orientation. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that these effects are concentrated among firms with higher ex-ante tail risk and greater information asymmetry, where governance improvements are most valuable to debt holders. Robustness tests using California's SB 826 mandate yield consistent results. Our findings demonstrate that board gender diversity enhances governance in ways valued by credit markets.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2017年三大资产管理公司的治理运动作为外生冲击，研究发现董事会性别多样性通过降低杠杆率和改善利益相关者导向，显著降低了企业债券融资成本和提升了信用评级。
AI.research_question: 董事会性别多样性对企业债券融资成本的因果影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨董事会性别多样性如何影响公司治理质量，进而影响债务融资成本，为性别多样性的经济价值提供实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公司治理理论和利益相关者理论，认为性别多样性能够改善董事会监督职能和决策质量。
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），利用2017年BlackRock、Vanguard和State Street的治理运动作为外生冲击。
AI.findings: 受运动影响更大的公司债券收益率利差显著降低，信用评级改善；机制是通过降低杠杆率和改善利益相关者导向；效应在事前尾部风险高和信息不对称程度大的公司中更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 为董事会性别多样性影响公司治理的机制提供了因果证据，丰富了公司治理和债务融资理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了性别多样性改善公司治理和降低融资成本的实际证据，支持多样性政策的实施。

title: From Policy to Practice: Strengthening Public Service Delivery through the Haryana Right to Service Act and the Auto Appeal System
affiliations: Centre for Good Governance and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Policy to Practice: Strengthening Public Service Delivery through the Haryana Right to Service Act and the Auto Appeal System

declarations.ethicsApproval: The study is conducted with consent of Haryana Right to Service Commission and is under consideration for print with 'Indian Journal of Public Administration' SAGE publications

detail.abstract: Haryana is a state located in North-Central part of India. It is a state that borders India's capital, New Delhi. Haryana, which makes up less than 2% of India's population and only 1.37% of its total land area, has distinguished itself over the last three decades. Haryana Right to Service Act came into force on 26th March 2014. It is an important initiative in ensuring time bound delivery to service to the citizens. The current research critically examines the implementation and impact of the Haryana Right to Service Act, 2014 and explores the effectiveness of the Auto Appeal System (AAS), introduced in 2021 as an ICTenabled solution to overcome challenges in service delivery. The study uses a qualitative research design and draws on primary data from interviews with officials at Haryana Right to Service Commission, as well as secondary data from the Antyodaya SARAL and AAS portals. The findings show that the integration of AAS significantly enhanced service compliance timelines, decreased appeal-related delays, enforced accountability through automatic escalation mechanisms and contributed to environmental sustainability by digitizing the redressal process. The study also emphasizes the favorable institutional and administrative reforms prompted by the Act, as well as the acknowledgment of Haryana's model as a replicable framework for citizen-centric governance. Overall, this research demonstrates how legal backing combined with digital innovation can foster good governance, promote citizen trust and provide a roadmap for other states seeking to implement right-to-service frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度哈里亚纳邦2014年《服务权利法案》的实施效果，重点分析了2021年引入的自动上诉系统(AAS)如何通过数字化手段改善服务交付效率、加强问责制，并成为可复制的公民中心治理模式。
AI.research_question: 哈里亚纳邦《服务权利法案》的实施效果如何？自动上诉系统(AAS)作为ICT解决方案在克服服务交付挑战方面的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 哈里亚纳邦虽然只占印度人口不到2%和土地面积1.37%，但在过去三十年中表现突出。2014年实施的《服务权利法案》是确保公民时限服务交付的重要举措，需要评估其实施效果和创新数字解决方案的有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于良好治理理论、数字政府理论和公民中心服务交付理论，探讨法律支持与数字创新如何协同促进政府服务改革。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，收集哈里亚纳邦服务权利委员会官员的访谈数据（一手数据），以及Antyodaya SARAL和AAS门户网站的二手数据。
AI.findings: AAS系统的整合显著提高了服务合规时间表，减少了上诉相关延迟，通过自动升级机制强化了问责制，数字化申诉流程还促进了环境可持续性。法案推动了有利的制度和行政改革，哈里亚纳模式被认可为可复制的公民中心治理框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字治理理论，证明了法律授权与技术创新结合对促进良好治理的理论价值，为服务权利框架的实施提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他邦实施服务权利框架提供了可操作的路线图，展示了如何通过数字化解决方案提升政府服务效率、增强公民信任，并建立了可复制的治理模式。

title: AI Self-preferencing in Algorithmic Hiring: Empirical Evidence and Insights
affiliations: University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business, National University of Singapore (NUS) - School of Computing and Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Management Sciences

detail.title: AI Self-preferencing in Algorithmic Hiring: Empirical Evidence and Insights
detail.abstract: As generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools become widely adopted, large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved on both sides of decision-making processes, ranging from hiring to content moderation. This dual adoption raises a critical question: do LLMs systematically favor content that resembles their own outputs? Prior research in computer science has identified self-preference bias---the tendency of LLMs to favor their own generated content---but its real-world implications have not been empirically evaluated. We focus on the hiring context, where job applicants often rely on LLMs to refine resumes, while employers deploy them to screen those same resumes. Using a large-scale controlled resume correspondence experiment, we find that LLMs consistently prefer resumes generated by themselves over those written by humans or produced by alternative models, even when content quality is controlled. The bias against human-written resumes is particularly substantial, with self-preference bias ranging from 68% to 88% across major commercial and open-source models. To assess labor market impact, we simulate realistic hiring pipelines across 24 occupations. These simulations show that candidates using the same LLM as the evaluator are 23% to 60% more likely to be shortlisted than equally qualified applicants submitting human-written resumes, with the largest disadvantages observed in business-related fields such as sales and accounting. We further demonstrate that this bias can be reduced by more than 50% through simple interventions targeting LLMs' self-recognition capabilities. These findings highlight an emerging but previously overlooked risk in AI-assisted decision making and call for expanded frameworks of AI fairness that address not only demographic-based disparities, but also biases in AI-AI interactions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型在招聘决策中存在自我偏好偏见，倾向于选择自己生成的简历而非人工撰写的内容，这种偏见在模拟招聘流程中导致使用相同LLM的候选人获得23%-60%的额外优势，但可通过简单干预减少50%以上。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型是否系统性地偏好自己生成的内容？这种自我偏好偏见在招聘决策中的实际影响如何？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI工具广泛采用，LLMs在决策过程的两端（求职者优化简历和雇主筛选简历）都参与其中，这种双重采用引发了关于LLMs是否偏好自身输出内容的重要问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计算机科学中已识别的自我偏好偏见理论，即LLMs倾向于偏好自己生成的内容，但此前缺乏实证评估其现实影响。
AI.method: 采用大规模受控简历对应实验，比较LLMs对不同来源简历的偏好；模拟24个职业的现实招聘流程来评估劳动力市场影响；测试针对LLMs自我识别能力的简单干预措施效果。
AI.findings: LLMs consistently prefer resumes generated by themselves over those written by humans or produced by alternative models, with self-preference bias ranging from 68% to 88% across major commercial and open-source models. Candidates using the same LLM as the evaluator are 23% to 60% more likely to be shortlisted than equally qualified applicants submitting human-written resumes, with the largest disadvantages observed in business-related fields such as sales and accounting. This bias can be reduced by more than 50% through simple interventions targeting LLMs' self-recognition capabilities.
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI公平性框架，提出需要关注不仅基于人口统计的差异，还要解决AI-AI交互中的偏见问题；为自我偏好偏见理论提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了AI辅助决策中一个新兴但被忽视的风险；提供了减少自我偏好偏见的有效干预措施；对招聘行业和AI系统设计具有重要实践意义。

title: Legal and Organizational Aspects of the Development of Entrepreneurship in Bulgaria
affiliations: Trakia University, Independent and Kaneff University Hospital

detail.title: Legal and Organizational Aspects of the Development of Entrepreneurship in Bulgaria

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: Not applicable

detail.abstract: The development of entrepreneurship in Bulgaria has its historical traditions and a certain amount of experience. Over the years of transition from a planned to a market economy, a set of deficits has accumulated, which have been identified. Still, the complexity of overcoming them and resistance has led to significant problems. This paper examines the legal and organizational aspects of entrepreneurship development, based on a certain comparison of the development of other countries that are members of the European Union. An attempt is made not only to define problem areas, but also to give certain recommendations for their elimination. The analysis is based on the expertise of the authors, which has been accumulated in the management of the central state administration and the management of small and medium-sized enterprises.

AI.tldr: 本文分析保加利亚企业家精神发展的法律和组织问题，通过与欧盟国家对比提出改进建议
AI.research_question: 保加利亚企业家精神发展遇到的主要法律和组织障碍是什么？如何通过学习欧盟国家经验来解决这些问题？

title: Dynamic Alignment: A Framework for Strategic Ambidexterity in Business Transformation
affiliations: Institute for Change Leadership and Business Transformation

detail.title: Dynamic Alignment: A Framework for Strategic Ambidexterity in Business Transformation
detail.abstract: Organizations face the dual imperative of driving transformation while maintaining reliable operations. Yet many change initiatives falter not because of flawed execution alone, but because continuity is undervalued as a strategic capability. This essay addresses the guiding question: How can organizations reconcile transformation with continuity, and what role does continuity play as a strategic capability in enabling sustainable change? The analysis argues that sustainable transformation requires cultivating strategic ambidexterity, defined as the capacity to balance exploration and exploitation through what is here introduced as adaptive continuity. Continuity should not be conceived as inertia or resistance, but as a dynamic capability that preserves coherence, sustains trust, and provides the foundation for controlled and scalable change. The principal contribution of this work is the Dynamic Alignment Model, an original conceptual framework that integrates ambidexterity, resilience, and change leadership to reframe continuity as a core element of strategic transformation. The model identifies mechanisms such as phased change, cultural anchors, proactive risk management, employee engagement, knowledge management, and value co-creation as practical levers that enable organizations to align continuity and innovation. Conceptual scenarios, complemented by illustrative examples, demonstrate the risks of privileging one pole in isolation and the advantages of cultivating both simultaneously. By positioning continuity at the center of transformation, this essay advances a new foundation for research and practice. It shows that resilience and long-term competitiveness emerge not from eliminating paradox but from navigating it deliberately, drawing strength from the interplay of stability and change.

title: The Role of Prescreening in Auctions with Predictions
affiliations: Imperial College Business School, Imperial College London, Business School, University of California, Berkeley and Imperial College Business School

detail.title: The Role of Prescreening in Auctions with Predictions
detail.abstract:
Sellers often prescreen potential bidders, restricting participation to a select group of capable participants. Recent advances in machine learning and generative AI make this strategy increasingly viable by enabling the cost‑effective identification of high‑quality bidders. However, the practice departs from classic auction theory, which usually favors broad competition over selective exclusion. In this paper, we examine whether and under what conditions bidder prescreening can be justified. We analyze a setting in which bidders have independent and identically distributed private valuations, and the seller observes noisy signals generated by a valuation predictor. The seller determines how many top bidders to admit and, after receiving signals, selects exactly that many with the highest signal‑based rankings. We demonstrate that an auction with prescreening is equivalent to a standard auction (i.e., without prescreening) but with correlated valuations. Our analysis shows that, although admitting fewer bidders leads to revenue losses in both second-price and first-price auctions, a more accurate predictor can mitigate or even fully offset these losses. In contrast, prescreening can significantly boost revenue in all-pay auctions; notably, when the predictor is perfect, admitting only two bidders is optimal. All results remain valid in the presence of reserve prices.
“The success of transactions depends even more on what happens before and after the auction. Understanding the transaction as a whole requires one to ask who participates...” — Putting Auction Theory to Work (Milgrom, 2004)

AI.tldr: 本文研究竞拍者预筛选策略，发现在第二价格和第一价格拍卖中，虽然减少竞拍者数量会降低收入，但更准确的估值预测器可以抵消这些损失；在全支付拍卖中，预筛选能显著提高收入，完美预测器时仅允许两个竞拍者最优。
AI.research_question: 竞拍者预筛选是否以及在什么条件下可以被证明是合理的？
AI.motivation: 机器学习生成式AI的进步使得卖家能够经济高效地识别高质量竞拍者，但这种选择性排除的做法与经典拍卖理论主张广泛竞争的观点相悖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于独立同分布私人估值的拍卖理论，引入估值预测器产生的噪声信号，将预筛选拍卖等价于具有相关估值的标准拍卖。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，卖家观察估值预测器产生的噪声信号，选择信号排名最高的特定数量竞拍者参与拍卖。
AI.findings: 1) 二价和一价拍卖中减少竞拍者会损失收入，但更准确预测器可抵消损失；2) 全支付拍卖中预筛选能显著提升收入，完美预测器时仅允许两个竞拍者最优；3) 所有结果在存在保留价时仍然成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 将预筛选拍卖与具有相关估值的标准拍卖建立等价关系，拓展了拍卖理论对参与约束的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使用AI技术进行竞拍者筛选的实践提供了理论依据，特别是在全支付拍卖场景中证明了预筛选的价值。

title: The EU's €150 Billion Defence Loan: A Critical Juncture Between Neoliberalism and Realist Protectionism

detail.title: The EU's €150 Billion Defence Loan: A Critical Juncture Between Neoliberalism and Realist Protectionism

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have influenced this work.

detail.abstract: The Russian invasion of Ukraine in 2022, combined with the growing uncertainty over U.S security guarantees, has exposed critical vulnerabilities within existing European Union defence Architecture. In response, the EU announced its £150 Billion defence loan in 2025, as a part of the broader 'Rearm Europe initiative', aimed at strengthening strategic autonomy, reducing reliance on traditional U.S supply chains, and economically protecting domestic industries. This paper argues that this policy represents more than a reactionary pragmatic response to regional instability and security risks but marks a critical juncture in the EU's political economy, signaling a shift away from long standing neoliberal hegemony toward resurging realist and protectionist strategies. With the application of Critical Juncture Theory, Neoliberalism and Realism, this paper positions the loan as a contingent choice with potential path-dependent consequences for EU security, sovereignty and the continuity of the modern neoliberal order. Through it's clear prioritization of domestic industry, state-led intervention and increasing strategic autonomy, this initiative directly challenges neoliberal assumptions of the modern free market framework and long-standing global interdependence. Furthermore, the defence loan reflects a deeper international reorientation of the EU's fluctuating identity within international political economy, potentially embedding realist principles into its long-term ideological and practical trajectory.

detail.abstract: Financial diagnosis has become an increasingly significant tool for assessing an organization's financial health, offering a more forward-thinking and multifaceted perspective than the traditional financial audit. This paper investigates the core elements of financial diagnosis, focusing on its definition, expanding boundaries, and the ongoing need for organized diagnostic frameworks in contemporary financial analysis. Through a thorough review of theoretical viewpoints and practical methodologies, the study compares financial diagnosis with conventional audit practices, highlighting the differences in their objectives, analytical tactics, and resulting insights. The discussion further examines methodological advances that have transformed financial diagnosis into a hybrid practice, combining quantitative data with qualitative understanding. Alongside outlining the historical development of the field, the paper presents a critical comparative analysis, explores relevant theoretical foundations, and points out important implications for both academic research and real-world application. Ultimately, this work seeks to establish the conceptual and methodological credibility of financial diagnosis as a distinct analytical discipline, vital for meeting the evolving requirements of financial management.

title: Glory, Pain and Hope: Sociopolitical Identity in Colombia (1920-2025)
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Glory, Pain and Hope: Sociopolitical Identity in Colombia (1920-2025)
detail.abstract: This paper presents a sociological analysis of the first verse of the Colombian National Anthem, exploring its symbolic value in the construction of identity and social cohesion between 1920 and 2025. Based on the postulates of Émile Durkheim and the theory of cultural transmission, it interprets how these lyrics have served as a mechanism of social integration, legitimizing the relationship between rulers and ruled in the public sphere. The research suggests that the anthem, by evoking freedom and national awakening, remains relevant to current generations, strengthening the solid identity necessary for democratic governance processes and decision-making at different levels of public administration.

title: Application of an Industry 4.0 Implementation Model: Digital Twin-Based Predictive Maintenance of a Polish Filter in Palm Oil Refining

detail.title: Application of an Industry 4.0 Implementation Model: Digital Twin-Based Predictive Maintenance of a Polish Filter in Palm Oil Refining
detail.abstract: This contribution illustrates the practical application of a recently developed Industry 4.0 deployment model for maintenance optimization within a palm oil refining company. A key part of this application is the development of a digital twin prototype for a critical polishing filter, designed to support real-time process monitoring and predictive maintenance strategies at the same time, the remaining useful life (RUL) of the filter's internal sleeves is predicted using advanced machine learning methods. In particular, the Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) algorithm is applied to historical process data to predict sleeve degradation cycles.

AI.tldr: 本研究展示了一种新发展的产业4.0部署模型在油榈精炼公司中的维护优化应用，包括关键滤波器的数字双胞原型开发和使用XGBoost算法预测绳套的剩余使用寿命

title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Legend Of La Llorona
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: Moral Philosophy and Archetypes in the Symbolic Cohesion of the Legend Of La Llorona
detail.abstract: This study analyzes the moralizing value of the Colombian legend of La Llorona, interpreting her as an “anti-villain” who, despite being feared, pursues a collective good. Drawing on Machiavelli’s and Hobbes’s theories of the ethics of fear, the paper examines how the legend conveys a pedagogy of terror that operates as both a social control mechanism and an ecological safeguard. The fear embodied by La Llorona not only regulates individual behavior but also strengthens communal norms and preserves natural resources against transgression. Thus, the myth emerges as a cultural tool that sustains social cohesion and ancestral knowledge, demonstrating how oral traditions embed moral lessons in supernatural narratives.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析哥伦比亚La Llorona传说的道德教化价值，将其解读为追求集体利益的'反反派'，探讨传说如何通过恐惧伦理实现社会控制和生态保护的双重功能。
AI.research_question: La Llorona传说如何通过恐惧伦理机制实现社会控制和生态保护的双重道德教化功能？
AI.motivation: 探讨民间传说中恐怖元素的社会功能，分析超自然叙事如何承载道德教化和生态保护的文化智慧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马基雅维利和霍布斯的恐惧伦理理论，认为恐惧可以作为社会控制和道德教化的有效工具。
AI.method: 文本分析和理论阐释，对La Llorona传说进行道德哲学视角的解读。

AI.practical_contributions: 为传统文化保护和教育实践提供了理论依据，展示了口头传统在道德教育和生态意识培养中的价值。

title: What are the Ethical Positions in Israel Regarding the Development of an Artificial Womb?
affiliations: Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Hebrew University and Bank of Israel

detail.title: What are the Ethical Positions in Israel Regarding the Development of an Artificial Womb?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: non
declarations.ethicsApproval: survey with full disclosure and without sensitive data
declarations.funderStatement: non

detail.abstract: In this study, we sought to examine public attitudes toward the development and use of an artificial womb. The development of an artificial womb is advancing globally, and the discourse surrounding it is not detached from the conversation about surrogacy; both discussions raise similar ethical challenges. Some view extra-corporeal pregnancy as the alternative and preferred solution for childbirth that does not occur in the biological mother's womb, as it bypasses many ethical dilemmas related to the woman's body and the emotional complexities of carrying a child for someone else. Others argue that this is a fundamentally different development, and therefore the ethical discourse around it must be distinct and unique. We examined how attitudes towards the use of an artificial womb are influenced by religious inclination, age, level of education, and other demographic characteristics of the individual. To investigate this question, we distributed an electronic survey through social networks. The survey included a series of questions about the respondent's characteristics (gender, age, religiosity, income, education), their attitudes towards various possible uses of an artificial womb, and finally, their reflections on the topic after being exposed to the information and possibilities presented in the questionnaire. We based our analysis on responses received shortly after its distribution, with the majority of respondents being educated women from the Jewish sector. The results we obtained demonstrate the importance of women's involvement in decision-making processes and in technological developments concerning the traditional role of the female body. While we did not find significant differences in responses when segmented by different levels of religiosity, we did find a correlation between the level of education and the respondents' openness to innovation. Higher education and openness to technological changes contribute to the support of women, including traditional ones, for developments that challenge traditional perceptions of the female body's role in nature. However, when it becomes clear that the uses of this technology diverge from traditional goals, women adjust their positions and express concerns about potential future applications. Although the findings are limited to the characteristics of the surveyed group and deal with a hypothetical world scenario for the respondents, we believe this research can serve as a model for necessary interaction with the public in the development of new technologies. Furthermore, we hope this research will serve as an incentive and further encouragement for talented and educated young women from all backgrounds to integrate into the fields of science and technology in general, and to take a more significant part in projects and decisions concerning their own bodies in particular.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过调查调查公众对人工子宮技术的态度，发现教育程度和技术开放性与支持度正相关，女性在技术决策中的参与至关重要。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物伦理学和技术接受度理论，考察人口统计因素对新技术态度的影响机制。
AI.method: 通过社交网络分发电子问卷调查，收集了解被调查者的人口统计特征、对人工子宮不同用途的态度以及在了解技术信息后的反思。
AI.findings: 高等教育程度和技术开放性与支持人工子宮技术正相关；当技术用途偏离传统目标时，女性会调整立场并表达担忧；宗教倾向没有导致显著态度差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了技术接受度理论在生物医学伦理领域的应用，提供了公众参与新技术发展讨论的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了女性在技术决策过程中的重要作用，为新技术开发中的公众沟通提供模板，鼓励了年轻女性进入科技领域。

title: Bridging the Mobile Trust Gap: A Zero Trust Framework for Consumer-Facing Applications
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Bridging the Mobile Trust Gap: A Zero Trust Framework for Consumer-Facing Applications
detail.abstract: Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) has become a widely adopted model for securing enterprise environments, promoting continuous verification and minimal trust across systems. However, its application in mobile contexts remains limited, despite mobile applications now accounting for most global digital interactions and being increasingly targeted by sophisticated threats. Existing Zero Trust frameworks developed by organisations such as the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) primarily focus on enterprise-managed infrastructure, assuming organisational control over devices, networks, and identities. This paper addresses a critical gap by proposing an extended Zero Trust model designed for mobile applications operating in untrusted, user-controlled environments. Using a design science methodology, the study introduced a six-pillar framework that supports runtime enforcement of trust through controls including device integrity, user identity validation, data protection, secure application programming interface (API) usage, behavioural monitoring, and live application protection. Each pillar was mapped to relevant regulatory and security standards to support compliance. A phased implementation roadmap and maturity assessment model were also developed to guide adoption across varying organisational contexts. The proposed model offers a practical and standards-aligned approach to securing mobile applications beyond pre-deployment controls, aligning real-time enforcement with Zero Trust principles. This contribution expands the operational boundaries of ZTA and provides organisations with a deployable path to reduce fraud, enhance compliance, and address emerging mobile security challenges. Future research may include empirical validation of the framework and cross-sector application testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对移动应用的扩展零信任架构模型，通过六支柱框架在不受信任的用户控制环境中实现运行时信任执行，填补了现有零信任框架在移动环境应用的空白。
AI.research_question: 如何在用户控制的不受信任移动环境中有效实施零信任架构来保护移动应用安全？
AI.motivation: 尽管零信任架构在企业环境中广泛应用，但现有框架主要针对企业管理的设备，而移动应用占全球数字交互的大部分且面临日益复杂的威胁，移动环境下的零信任应用存在明显空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于NIST和CISA的零信任架构理论，结合移动安全特性和用户控制环境的特点，构建扩展的零信任理论框架。
AI.method: 采用设计科学研究方法，开发包含六个支柱的框架，包括设备完整性、用户身份验证、数据保护、安全API使用、行为监控和实时应用保护。
AI.findings: 提出了一个实用的、符合标准的移动应用零信任模型，包含分阶段实施路线图和成熟度评估模型，能够指导不同组织环境的采用。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了零信任架构的操作边界，为移动应用在不受信任环境中的安全保护提供了理论框架和方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了可部署的路径来减少欺诈、增强合规性并应对新兴的移动安全挑战，支持运行时执行与零信任原则的对齐。

title: Effect of Public Spending on Education on Economic Growth in Peru: A Cointegration Approach, 1990-2023
affiliations: Universidad Nacional de Frontera, National University of the Altiplano Puno, Universidad Nacional de José and Universidad Nacional

detail.title: Effect of Public Spending on Education on Economic Growth in Peru: A Cointegration Approach, 1990-2023
detail.abstract: This study aimed to analyze the effect of public spending on education on Peru’s economic growth during the period 1990–2023, using a cointegration approach to identify both short- and long-term relationships among the selected variables. The research was based on the importance of human capital as a driver of growth and the need to evaluate the efficiency of educational public spending. An econometric methodology based on time series models was applied, specifically the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) model, complemented by unit root tests (ADF), stationarity analysis, series decomposition using the Hodrick-Prescott filter, volatility analysis, correlations, and regressions. Independent variables included current educational spending, educational infrastructure investment, gross fixed capital formation (FBCF), economically active population (PEA), healthcare spending, and exports. The results showed that economic growth (ΔGDP) recorded an annual average of 3.88% with high volatility. Correlations between ΔGDP and the selected variables were low or weak, with a coefficient of -0.29 for current educational spending, suggesting nonimmediate effects. However, the ARDL model evidenced a long-term equilibrium relationship between educational spending and economic growth. It was concluded that public spending on education contributed to long-term growth, conditioned by factors such as spending efficiency, political stability, and the quality of the education system.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析1990-2023年秘鲁教育公共支出对经济增长的影响，使用ARDL模型发现教育支出与经济增长存在长期均衡关系，但短期相关性较弱。
AI.research_question: 教育公共支出对秘鲁经济增长的影响是什么？是否存在短期和长期关系？
AI.motivation: 基于人力资本作为增长驱动因素的重要性，以及评估教育公共支出效率的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论，教育支出作为人力资本投资对经济增长的影响机制。
AI.method: 时间序列计量经济学方法，包括ARDL模型、单位根检验（ADF）、平稳性分析、Hodrick-Prescott滤波分解、波动性分析、相关性和回归分析。
AI.findings: 经济增长年均3.88%但波动性高；教育支出与经济增长相关性弱（-0.29）；ARDL模型显示存在长期均衡关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了教育支出作为人力资本投资对长期经济增长的重要作用，补充了发展经济学中公共支出效率的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为秘鲁政府制定教育政策提供实证依据，强调需要关注支出效率、政治稳定性和教育质量等条件因素。

title: Advancing Sustainability through Eco-Design in the Circular Economy: A Bibliometric Analysis
affiliations: Iran University of Science and Technology, Iran University of Science and Technology, Iran University of Science and Technology, Iran University of Science and Technology, Iran University of Science and Technology - School of Architecture & Environmental Design and Iran University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Advancing Sustainability through Eco-Design in the Circular Economy: A Bibliometric Analysis
detail.abstract: Product design has seen growing integration of the circular economy and eco-design, but there is not enough in-depth research of their intersection. This paper offers to bridge this gap by examining the co-occurrence and relationship between the circular economy and eco-design in product design. Scopus was used as the data source, and VOSviewer and RStudio were used to create a bibliometric analysis. Visual analysis was employed to trace the research lineage. This study explores the evolving landscape of research in eco-design, circular economy, and sustainability, noting that since 2004, the number of publications in this field has increased in various countries, and China and the United States have had the most global collaboration in this area. Utilizing bibliometric and co-occurrence analyses, the eight thematic clusters found are based on end-to-end product development, sustainable production, design optimization, and lifecycle management. The research bridges the gap in combining traditional eco-design concepts with the newly emerging concepts such as circular economy and Industry 4.0, corroborating the trend towards greater inter-disciplinary research collaboration. This study emphasizes the convergence of environmental protection, industrial management, and computer-aided design to promote environmental innovations and sustainable practices. It also emphasizes the need for incorporating financial and technology components into eco-design strategies to evolve greener and more sustainable economic and production systems. Last but not least, this study provides a guidebook for sustainable product design by converging circular economy ideas and technology.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献计量学方法分析了循环经济与生态设计在产品设计领域的交叉研究，发现2004年以来该领域研究增长迅速，中国和美国合作最多，识别出8个主题集群，强调了环境、工业管理和计算机辅助设计的融合趋势。
AI.research_question: 循环经济与生态设计在产品设计领域的共现关系和交叉研究现状如何？
AI.motivation: 产品设计中循环经济和生态设计的整合日益增多，但缺乏对其交叉关系的深入研究，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于循环经济理论、生态设计理论和可持续发展理论，构建文献计量分析框架。
AI.method: 使用Scopus数据库作为数据源，运用VOSviewer和RStudio进行文献计量分析和共现分析，采用可视化分析方法追踪研究脉络。
AI.findings: 自2004年以来该领域出版物数量增加，中美合作最多；识别出8个主题集群：端到端产品开发、可持续生产、设计优化和生命周期管理等；证实了跨学科研究合作趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统生态设计概念与循环经济、工业4.0等新兴概念相结合，填补了理论交叉研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可持续产品设计指南，强调将金融和技术要素纳入生态设计策略，促进环境创新和可持续实践，推动更绿色可持续的经济和生产系统发展。

title: Echoes of Green Financial Policies in Pandemic Waves: Adaptive Interplay with China's Industrial Enterprise Performance
affiliations: Southwest Minzu University, Southwest Minzu University, Xihua University and Xihua University

detail.title: Echoes of Green Financial Policies in Pandemic Waves: Adaptive Interplay with China's Industrial Enterprise Performance
detail.abstract: This study explores the impact of green finance policies (GFPs) on industrial enterprises' performance (IEP) before and after the COVID-19 pandemic, examining how the pandemic reshaped policy effectiveness, with technological innovation (TI) as a key mediator to clarify the comprehensive utility of GFPs. Using panel data of Chinese industrial enterprises (2016–2019 for the pre-pandemic period and 2020–2023 for the post-pandemic period), partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM) is applied to analyze temporal differences and annual variations in the GFP-IEP relationship. Key findings are as follows: (1) The direct positive effect of GFPs on IEP weakened in the post-pandemic period, shifting from a significant positive impact pre-pandemic to an insignificant negative effect, indicating pandemic-induced disruptions. (2) The indirect effect of GFPs on IEP via TI remained robust across both periods, confirming TI as a crisis-adaptive stabilizer. (3) Post-pandemic temporal heterogeneity was observed: the GFP-IEP relationship shifted from positive in 2020 to significantly negative in 2021 and 2022, before becoming insignificant in 2023. Additionally, population mobility (MOB) moderated GFP efficacy under pandemic-related restrictions. This study contextualizes GFP effects amid exogenous crises, highlights TI's resilience, and quantifies temporal dynamics. By identifying TI as a policy effect "stabilizer", it offers concrete paths to optimize post-pandemic green finance policies, advising policymakers to balance economic recovery and sustainability via strengthened innovation incentives and flexible measures to enhance crisis resilience and mitigate socio-economic disruptions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了绿色金融政策（GFPs）在新冠疫情前后对工业企业绩效（IEP）的影响，发现疫情削弱了政策的直接正面效应，但技术创新（TI）作为中介机制在危机期间保持稳定作用，为后疫情时代绿色金融政策优化提供了实证依据。
AI.research_question: 绿色金融政策在新冠疫情前后对工业企业绩效的影响有何变化？技术创新在其中扮演什么中介角色？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情作为外生冲击可能重塑绿色金融政策的有效性，需要实证检验政策在危机期间的适应性和技术创新在其中的稳定器作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于绿色金融理论、技术创新理论和危机管理理论，构建了政策-创新-绩效的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2016-2023年中国工业企业面板数据，采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析时间差异和年度变化。
AI.findings: 1）GFPs对IEP的直接正面效应在疫情后减弱；2）通过TI的间接效应在两时期均保持稳健；3）存在后疫情时期的时间异质性；4）人口流动性在疫情限制下调节GFPs效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将绿色金融政策效果置于外生危机背景下考察，识别技术创新作为政策效应"稳定器"的理论机制，量化时间动态变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化后疫情时代绿色金融政策提供具体路径，建议通过加强创新激励和灵活措施来平衡经济复苏与可持续发展，增强危机韧性。

title: Financialization, "Innovation" and Neoliberalism: A Note
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Financialization, "Innovation" and Neoliberalism: A Note
detail.abstract: In this note the author extends his prior discussion of economic "financialization" to consider the implications of financialization for the area of research and development specifically. Doing so the author argues that in a financialized economy, and particularly a long-financialized economy, the results will include the privatization of the funding of R & D and its orientation to business' short-term priorities; an increasing tendency to "sustaining" rather than "disruptive" innovation, and to business' selling the customer "more" of what they already produce; and the orientation of much R & D to financial activity specifically such as rent-seeking or speculation. The author also argues that this financialization is plausibly a significant factor in the technological stagnation of recent decades.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨金融化对研发的影响，认为金融化导致研发资金私有化、偏向短期商业利益、维持性创新而非颠覆性创新，以及研发活动转向金融投机，这可能是近几十年技术停滞的重要原因。
AI.research_question: 金融化对研发活动有什么影响？
AI.motivation: 作者希望将之前关于经济金融化的讨论延伸到研发领域，探讨金融化如何影响技术创新和发展模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融化理论，关注金融资本对实体经济的影响，特别是对研发和创新活动的扭曲作用。
AI.method: 理论分析和论证，基于作者之前的金融化研究框架进行延伸分析。
AI.findings: 金融化导致研发资金私有化、偏向短期商业利益、维持性创新而非颠覆性创新，研发活动转向金融投机如寻租和投机行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了金融化理论的应用范围，建立了金融化与研发活动、技术创新模式之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解近几十年技术停滞现象提供了新的解释视角，对政策制定者和企业管理者在研发投资决策方面具有启示意义。

title: The Familiness Matrix: A Configurational Instrument to Capture Heterogeneity in Family Firm Logics
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Turin and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Familiness Matrix: A Configurational Instrument to Capture Heterogeneity in Family Firm Logics
detail.abstract: The concept of “familiness” is key to understanding what makes the difference between a family and a non-family firm, as well as across heterogeneous family firms. This study leverages a cross-theoretical literature review to inductively develop an operationalizable list of 32 familiness attributes, viewed as types of organizational logic. These attributes are clustered into 10 sub-dimensions and four dimensions of familiness (Value Proposition Familiness; Investment Familiness; Involvement Familiness; and Work Environment Familiness). The resulting Familiness Framework provides a scalable and adaptable multi-dimensional, meta-theoretical typology for configurational analyses, thus enabling a more comprehensive understanding of family business archetypes, heterogeneity, and success. The emerging framework is shaped as a double-entry Familiness Matrix, with the aim of facilitating the configurational analysis of family firm heterogeneity through the lens of the interplay coherence between internal dimensions of familiness (Investment, Involvement, and Work Environment Familiness) and external dimensions (Value Proposition Familiness). The Familiness Matrix proposed by this study can be used as a basis for configurational (e.g., QCA) and/or longitudinal studies to identify family firm archetypes and their evolution, and to investigate how different combinations of internal and external familiness logics influence family firm performance and survival.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过跨理论文献回顾，归纳出32个家族性属性，构建了包含4个维度和10个子维度的家族性框架，提出了家族性矩阵用于分析家族企业异质性和绩效。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可操作的多维度家族性框架来理解家族企业的异质性和成功？
AI.motivation: 家族性概念对于区分家族与非家族企业以及理解家族企业间的异质性至关重要，但现有研究缺乏系统化的操作化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于组织逻辑理论，通过跨理论文献回顾构建家族性理论框架。
AI.method: 采用归纳性跨理论文献回顾方法，识别和聚类家族性属性。
AI.findings: 开发出包含32个属性的家族性框架，分为4个维度（价值主张家族性、投资家族性、参与家族性、工作环境家族性）和10个子维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个可扩展的多维度元理论类型学，为配置分析提供理论基础，促进对家族企业原型和异质性的更全面理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 家族性矩阵可作为配置分析（如QCA）和纵向研究的基础，识别家族企业原型及其演变，研究不同家族性逻辑组合如何影响企业绩效和生存。

title: The Labor Market and ESG Adoption in the Mutual Fund Industry
affiliations: Hofstra University

detail.title: The Labor Market and ESG Adoption in the Mutual Fund Industry
detail.abstract: Portfolio managers are more likely to join funds with an Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) profile similar to the profile of their current fund. When the two profiles are mismatched, managers shift the ESG of their new fund in the direction of their past ESG record. The latter effect is stronger when the new managers are more experienced and represent a larger percentage of the management team. The effect is well pronounced for managers with revealed preferences for both high and low ESG stocks, and funds in both more and less ESG-friendly states. Managers with strong ESG records exhibit better fund performance over the year following the appointment. The results suggest that the labor market is an important factor in the dissemination of ESG practices in the mutual fund industry.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了资产经理在基金行业中的ESG实践传播机制，发现经理们更愿意加入与自身ESG背景相似的基金，并会将新基金的ESG策略向自身历史记录调整，这种效应在经验丰富的经理中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 资产经理的职业流动如何影响基金行业中ESG实践的传播？
AI.motivation: 理解ESG投资在互聚基金行业中的普及机制，特别是劳务市场在其中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳务市场学派和资产经理个人偏好理论，探讨经理个人ESG偏好对基金ESG策略的影响。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，分析资产经理在不同基金之间流动的ESG策略调整行为。
AI.findings: 经理们更愿意加入ESG背景相似的基金，当ESG不匹配时会将新基金ESG向自身历史记录调整，这种效应在经验丰富的经理中更显著，且强ESG记录的经理表现出更好的基金绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了ESG投资理论，证明了劳务市场是ESG实践在基金行业传播的重要机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基金公司招聘ESG人才提供了实践指南，并为投资者选择具有强ESG能力的经理提供了依据。

title: Strategic Resource Decay and Utilization of Innovative Technologies
affiliations: University of Nebraska at Lincoln

detail.title: Strategic Resource Decay and Utilization of Innovative Technologies
detail.abstract: This study focuses on a particular type of resource bundling activity, which is a process that is examined more broadly in Study I (Chapter III). And unlike Study I which predicts firm performance, this study predicts the firms’ extent of utilization of an innovative technology. The results suggest that SRD is positively related to subsequent utilization of innovative technologies in the context of upstream oil and gas. Further, firms’ experimentation activity is also positively related to subsequent utilization of innovative technologies. However, the firm’s accumulated stock of resource-specific knowledge (of hydrocarbon basins in Texas) was not found to be a significant correlate of subsequent utilization of innovative technologies.

AI.tldr: 这份研究重点分析了一种特定资源组合活动，它在上游石油天然气行业中正向影响企业对创新技术的采用程度，其中SRD和实验活动都产生积极作用，但资源特定知识积累并不显著影响技术采用。
AI.research_question: 企业的资源组合活动如何影响其对创新技术的采用程度？
AI.motivation: 探索不同于传统企业绩效预测的因素，重点研究企业采用创新技术的关键驱动力
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观理论（Resource-Based View）和资源组合理论
AI.method: 实证研究方法，采用上游石油天然气行业数据，分析SRD、实验活动和知识积累对技术采用的影响
AI.findings: SRD和实验活动与创新技术采用呈显著正相关关系，但资源特定知识积累（得克萨斯水炭水化物盆地知识）对技术采用没有显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了资源基础观理论在技术采用领域的应用，明确了不同资源组合活动对技术创新的差异化影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油天然气企业提供了具体的管理建议，帮助企业通过SRD和实验活动提升创新技术采用能力

title: Applying the STARC Framework and STAR-CYCLE Model to Detect Behavioral Precursors in High-Risk Settings
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Applying the STARC Framework and STAR-CYCLE Model to Detect Behavioral Precursors in High-Risk Settings
detail.abstract: Early BackgroundEarly behavioral and cultural cues often surface before safety incidents but are overlooked due to ambiguity and the absence of field-ready detection methods. This study introduces the five-dimension STARC framework together with the STAR-CYCLE closed-loop intervention as a practical approach to identify and act on such silent precursors.MethodsA purposive sample of publicly available accident and near-miss narratives from high-risk industrial, healthcare, and organizational settings was analyzed using a structured codebook. Signals were coded across five dimensions—Shift, Ambiguity, Traceability, Risk Link, and Corrective Loop—and mapped to STAR-CYCLE stages. Descriptive frequencies and qualitative illustrations were used to examine recurring patterns and co-occurrences.ResultsAmbiguity and Traceability were the most frequent dimensions and commonly co-occurred with clear Risk Links in cases that escalated. Across contexts, the Corrective Loop was the weakest element, reflecting limited follow-up mechanisms after early signals. Case illustrations (ICU medication error, school laboratory splash injury, and process-plant pressurization incident) show how STARC could have enabled earlier, proportionate interventions.ConclusionReframing subtle human factors as actionable safety data via the integrated STARC/STAR-CYCLE approach provides a culturally adaptable pathway for proactive risk management. The framework complements dominant Western models and warrants prospective field pilots to quantify preventive impact.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了STARC框架和STAR-CYCLE闭环干预方法，用于识别和应对安全事故前的早期行为文化信号，通过分析高风险行业的公开事故报告发现模糊性和可追溯性是最常见的维度，纠正循环是最薄弱的环节。

AI.theoretical_framework: STARC五维度框架（Shift转变、Ambiguity模糊性、Traceability可追溯性、Risk Link风险关联、Corrective Loop纠正循环）和STAR-CYCLE闭环干预理论
AI.method: 采用目的性抽样方法，分析高风险工业、医疗和组织环境中公开的事故和未遂事件叙述，使用结构化编码手册进行编码分析
AI.findings: 模糊性和可追溯性是最频繁出现的维度，常与明确的风险关联共同出现在升级案例中；纠正循环是最薄弱的环节，反映了早期信号后缺乏后续机制

AI.practical_contributions: 提供了实用的STARC/STAR-CYCLE方法，可帮助组织早期识别安全风险并进行适当干预，补充了主流西方模型

detail.title: Keeping The Momentum: How Finance Can Continue to Support Growth in EMEs
detail.abstract: This paper examines how finance can support economic growth in emerging market economies (EMEs). Historically, finance has contributed to rising income levels, yet its future impact is less certain. Evidence indicates that as credit and income levels increase, the positive impact of finance on growth tends to weaken. Additionally, unchecked credit expansion can lead to financial busts, resulting in prolonged periods of sub-par economic performance. At the same time, advances in digital technologies offer new opportunities for enhancing financial intermediation. Policy decisions will be key in three main areas: implementing structural reforms to improve market-based finance access; harnessing digital technologies to enhance financial efficiency and inclusion; and maintaining macro-financial stability to ensure sustainable growth.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

detail.abstract:
When companies downsize, they often issue press releases announcing the layoffs. Increasingly often, senior leaders communicate the “bad news” internally using videos or text (letters, emails, or memos). This case analyzes the practice of writing “layoff letters” and provides five sample letters for analysis and critique. It also provides statistical data (e.g., word count) and content analysis (e.g., word frequency) of the letters.

This case is designed to help students understand the art of delivering bad news in the context of layoffs--what makes a compassionate but effective letter? It allows students to analyze and critique five actual letters to help them decide what makes a letter effective or not.

detail.title: Diversification Strategies and Investment Opportunities in the International Banking Industry

publicationDetails.detailsText: accepted for publication at Journal of International Money and Finance

detail.abstract: We examine whether and how banks’ diversification strategy responds to expected investment opportunities. We find evidence consistent with the view that whether banks diversify to develop internal funding capability in response to good prospects, or to search for new growth opportunities in response to poor prospects in the current activity, depends on external capital constraints. The results further suggest that banks find it optimal to have immediate control over the internal fund allocation rather than relying on the allocation managed by their group parent. We also find evidence suggesting that although international diversification can facilitate activity diversification, the former is unlikely to substitute for the latter. In addition, there is no evidence that activity diversification by banks reflects inefficient diversification.

title: CONCEPTUALISING THE NATURE, ORIGINS AND ROLES OF BUSINESS MODELS (AS) TYPES – A SYSTEMATIC INTEGRATIVE REVIEW
affiliations: Umeå University, BI Norwegian Business School and Umea School of Business and Economics

detail.title: CONCEPTUALISING THE NATURE, ORIGINS AND ROLES OF BUSINESS MODELS (AS) TYPES – A SYSTEMATIC INTEGRATIVE REVIEW
detail.abstract: Is a business model (BM) always a BM? While there is an apparent consensus on the definition of BM as the specific way a particular organisation creates and captures value, there is simultaneously a prevalent and often implicit reference in the literature to BMs as generic ways of value creation and capture, i.e., to BMs (as) types (BMTs). However, scholars tend to conflate the two due to the use of the same label and the lack of a clear and coherent conceptualisation of BMTs, leading to faulty conclusions, hindering the accumulation of knowledge, and limiting the ability to pose novel questions. We address this issue through a systematic integrative literature review of 364 articles, focusing on the nature, origins, and role of BMTs. We conceptualise BMTs, distinguish them from BMs, provide an integrative framework of the extant literature and establish essential avenues for future research. This review’s results offer a refined and extended understanding of BMTs, thereby advancing theory and enabling scholars to develop more rigorous and pertinent research. We also contribute to practice by providing actionable advice and a more refined vocabulary around BM(T)s.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过系统性综合文献综述解决了商业模式个体与类型的混淆问题，概念化了商业模式类型，提供了研究框架和未来研究方向。

title: Sensory Augmentation in Spatial Task Performance: Evaluating Haptic Guidance for Enhanced MemoryRetention in Industrial Environments
affiliations: Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology and Beijing Institute of Technology

detail.title: Sensory Augmentation in Spatial Task Performance: Evaluating Haptic Guidance for Enhanced MemoryRetention in Industrial Environments
detail.abstract: In the evolving world of human computer interaction, we’re learning that engagingmultiple senses can significantly boost how we learn and perform tasks. However, the specific role oftouch-based (haptic) feedback in helping people remember spatial sequences a vital skill on complexassembly lines hasn’t been thoroughly explored. Most existing training systems rely solely on visualinstructions, leaving a hole in our knowledge of how integrating sight and touch might enhanceprecision and lessen cognitive load. Our research set out to close this gap. We developed a noveltraining simulator that replicates an adult’s arm reach to test how different types of instructionsaffect the learning of 2D spatial patterns. We compared three methods: visual guides with verbalconfirmations (GV), visual guides with physical haptic guidance (GH), and visual instructions alone(VO). By measuring the number of practice attempts, accuracy, and user feedback, we found thatthe GV approach led to the strongest memory retention. Surprisingly, while haptic guidance (GH)didn’t outperform GV overall, it proved exceptionally valuable in complex tasks, cutting errorsby 18% compared to the visual-only method. It also made users feel more confident and reducedtheir cognitive load. These findings challenge the assumption that adding touch is always the bestsolution. Instead, they provide a clear, evidence backed framework for designers the most effectivetraining systems are those that thoughtfully match the instructional method to the specific task athand. For industrial training programs looking to enhance clarity and reduce errors, our work offerspractical guidance for balancing sensory input to optimize both performance and user experience.eeking to balance sensory load and instructional clarity.

AI.tldr: 研究表明，在空间序列记忆训练中，视觉引导加语音确认(GV)方法比触觉引导(GH)或纯视觉(VO)方法具有更好的记忆保持效果，但触觉引导在复杂任务中能显著减少18%的错误并降低认知负荷。
AI.research_question: 触觉反馈在帮助人们记忆空间序列任务中扮演什么具体角色？不同感官整合方式如何影响学习精度和认知负荷？
AI.motivation: 现有培训系统主要依赖视觉指导，缺乏对视觉与触觉整合如何提升精确度和减轻认知负荷的深入研究，特别是在复杂装配线等需要空间序列记忆的重要技能方面存在知识空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多感官学习理论、认知负荷理论、人机交互中的触觉反馈理论
AI.method: 开发新型训练模拟器模拟成人手臂伸展范围，比较三种指导方法：视觉引导加语音确认(GV)、视觉引导加物理触觉引导(GH)、纯视觉指导(VO)，通过测量练习次数、准确性和用户反馈进行评估。
AI.findings: GV方法产生最强的记忆保持效果；GH方法在复杂任务中表现突出，比VO方法减少18%错误，同时提升用户信心并降低认知负荷；触觉添加并非总是最佳解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"添加触觉总是最佳方案"的假设，提供了基于证据的框架，表明最有效的培训系统需要根据具体任务精心匹配教学方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业培训项目提供实用指导，帮助平衡感官输入以优化性能和用户体验，特别是在提升清晰度和减少错误方面。

title: Pareto Cube (Pareto³) Recursive Methodology for Strategic Analysis

detail.title: Pareto Cube (Pareto³) Recursive Methodology for Strategic Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article does not contain any studies with human participants or animals performed by the author.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This document introduces the Pareto Cube (Pareto³), a "cascade" methodology for solving complex problems, which integrates the Pareto Principle (80/20) with the "5 Whys" root cause analysis technique. The methodology recursively applies the Pareto principle to progressively distill the essential causes: from the Pareto Square (Pareto²), where ~4% of causes generate ~64% of the effects, to the Pareto Cube (Pareto³), where under 1% of causes can explain the majority of the impact (>51%). Two operating modes are presented: Strategic ("Light"), optimized for speed, and Systemic ("Complex"), optimized for deep understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了帕累托立方（Pareto³）方法，将帕累托原则（80/20法则）与"5个为什么"根因分析技术相结合，通过递归应用帕累托原则逐步提炼关键原因，从帕累托平方（~4%原因产生~64%效果）到帕累托立方（<1%原因解释>51%影响），并提供了战略（快速）和系统（深度）两种操作模式。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一种系统性的方法来有效识别和解决复杂问题中的关键根本原因？
AI.motivation: 传统的问题解决方法在处理复杂系统时往往效率低下，需要一种能够快速识别最关键影响因素的方法论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于帕累托原则（80/20法则）和根因分析理论，特别是"5个为什么"技术，构建了层级化的分析框架。
AI.method: 递归应用帕累托原则的分层分析方法，从帕累托平方到帕累托立方的渐进式提炼过程。
AI.findings: 开发出了帕累托立方方法，能够识别出不到1%的原因解释超过51%的影响，显著提高了问题解决的效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了帕累托原则的递归应用理论，扩展了传统80/20法则的应用深度和精度。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了两种实用的操作模式（战略模式和系统模式），可应用于各种复杂问题的分析和解决。

title: National Gold Reserve Trust (NGRT) - Partly Privatized National Gold Reserves
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: National Gold Reserve Trust (NGRT) - Partly Privatized National Gold Reserves
detail.abstract: The National Gold Reserve Trust (NGRT) is a proposed framework for partial privatization and securitization of a nation’s gold reserves. A portion of gold reserves would be placed into a publicly listed trust. Shares in the trust would be tradable in the private market. Shares could be used as collateral in central bank lending, with strict collateral ratios (e.g., 10% of loan value) and dynamic haircuts based on gold price volatility. Dividends from NGRT’s lending-related profits would be reinvested in gold, growing the reserve base over time.

AI.tldr: 提出了国家黄金储备信托（NGRT）框架，通过部分私有化和证券化国家黄金储备，将部分黄金放入公开上市的信托中，允许私人市场交易，并可作为央行贷款的抵押品，通过贷款利润再投资黄金来扩大储备基础。
AI.research_question: 如何通过部分私有化和证券化国家黄金储备来增强储备的流动性和增长性？
AI.motivation: 传统黄金储备缺乏流动性且无法产生收益，需要创新机制来提高黄金储备的利用效率和价值创造能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资产证券化理论、信托结构和中央银行货币政策工具理论，结合风险管理框架。
AI.method: 提出概念性框架设计，包括信托设立、股份交易机制、抵押品规则（严格抵押比率和动态折价）、利润再投资机制。
AI.findings: NGRT框架能够提高黄金储备的流动性，创造新的收益来源，并通过再投资机制实现储备的长期增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了国家储备管理的理论框架，提出了黄金储备证券化的创新模式，丰富了中央银行资产管理的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国央行提供了增强黄金储备流动性和收益性的实际操作方案，有助于优化国家储备结构，提高财政资源利用效率。
